tieu_de: EVIL PEOPLE CAN ALSO BECOME BUDDHAS
tom_tat: (Excerpt from the Sutra of a Hundred Charities) In the time of the Buddha, at that time, the Buddha was near the city of Sāvatthī together with the monks, in the garden of Jīvaka, the lay supporter. In the city of Sāvatthī, there was a wealthy householder named Bā-trì-gia (Vadrika).
noi_dung:
EVIL PEOPLE CAN ALSO BECOME BUDDHAS

(Excerpt from the Bhaddiya Sutta)

At the time of the Buddha, the Buddha was near the city of Savatthi together with the monks, in the garden of Anathapindika. In the city of Savatthi, there was a wealthy householder named Vadrika, rich but extremely wicked in heart, who was usually not friendly or close to anyone. Yet, he had respect and devotion for six teachers of other sects.

One day, he fell seriously ill, with no one to care for him or give him medicine, and his life was in grave danger. He then thought to himself:

"Today I am afflicted with illness, suffering this extreme misery; if anyone can save my life, I will serve and attend to that person for my entire life."

He then continued to think:

"Only the World-Honored Buddha can save my life."

With this thought, he developed a heartfelt longing, wishing to see the Buddha.

The Buddha often, with a mind of great compassion, day and night observes all beings, seeing who is suffering, and then appears accordingly to help, teaching the Dharma so that they may experience joy in body and mind. Even if someone is descending into evil paths, he helps them leave them and be born into the realms of gods and humans, thereby attaining enlightenment.

At that time, the Buddha saw the wealthy man suffering from illness, with no one to care for or nurture him. From afar, He radiated a beam of light toward the sick man's body, bringing comfort and coolness. Although the illness was not completely cured, his mind became enlightened and he felt immense joy. The wealthy man, Bā-ṭhī-gia, then turned toward the monastery where the Buddha was, prostrated, and paid homage back to the Buddha.

At that moment, the World-Honored One knew that Bā-ṭhī-gia's good roots had matured and that he could be taught. He then manifested

arrived at the house of this wealthy man. At that moment, he immediately got up, clasped his hands respectfully, and welcomed the Buddha to his seat.

The Buddha asked Bhatthiya:

- You are now suffering from illness and pain, do you know where it comes from? He replied:

- I am now suffering in both body and mind.

The Buddha then thought:

- From many past lives until now, I have practiced the virtue of compassion, vowing to cure all suffering and sickness in the body and mind of sentient beings.

At that time, Indra, the king of gods, knowing the thoughts of the Buddha, immediately flew to Perfume Mountain, took a medicinal herb called bạch nhũ, and brought it back to offer to the Buddha. The Buddha received the medicinal herb and handed it to Bà-trì-gia, instructing him to consume it entirely. The illness was immediately cured, and both body and mind were at peace and happiness.

This man, before the Buddha, developed a multiplied sense of faith and reverence, and immediately prepared various delicious and unusual foods to offer to the Buddha and the community of monks. Afterward, he also presented a fine robe, very beautiful, valued at a hundred thousand taels of gold, as an offering.

He then made a great vow that:

- Due to the merit of offering to the Buddha and the sangha of monks, I vow that in the future I will also be able to cure the physical and mental sufferings of all sentient beings, bringing them peace and happiness, just as today the World-Honored One has cured the sufferings of my body and mind, bringing me peace and happiness.

After he made such a vow, the Buddha immediately smiled, and from the space between His eyebrows a beam of five-colored light radiated, circling the Buddha three times before returning to the spot on His forehead.

At that time, Ananda said to the Buddha:

- The Tathagata is a noble being, never smiling without reason. Now, for what cause did the Buddha smile? Please explain so that we may know.

The Buddha said to Ananda:

- Did you see whether this wealthy man, after recovering from his illness, generated the mind of offering to me and the monks?

- Yes, World-Honored One, I have seen.

The Buddha said:

- In the future, this person will become a Buddha with the name Shakyamuni (the same name as Buddha Shakyamuni), widely saving countless beings. Because of this connection, I smiled.

The monks, after hearing the Buddha explain this cause and condition, were all joyful and accepted it with faith.

______________________

If you have read many stories about Rebirth and Cause and Effect, and then pondered and considered them, surely you also feel fear because of the danger of rebirth and the terror of karmic retribution.

Sentient beings keep reincarnating for countless lifetimes in the six realms, being born and then dying, enjoying little happiness but enduring endless suffering and torment, with countless blood and tears shed in the lifetimes of humans, animals, hungry ghosts, and hell beings.

Investigating the past lives of sentient beings in hell, who are being chopped and screamed at day and night amidst countless blood, tears, demons, and relentless fire. I see there are many people whose past lives also did very good deeds, who helped the poor, made offerings, built bridges and roads... all kinds of virtuous acts

Then, thanks to that virtue, in the next life they are reborn in places of comfort; some become wealthy and honored, some become officials, generals, kings, or even higher, reborn in the heavenly realm as deities or immortals. At that time, the nobility and wealth, the enjoyment of blessings make them deluded, no longer as virtuous as in the previous life. They begin to be arrogant, cruel, and commit countless sins. Killing living beings, sexual misconduct, harsh speech... as well as hundreds of thousands of other sins. The merit from the previous life cannot keep them from greed, anger, and ignorance in their hearts. <second life>

Finally, because of the sins they committed, they were dragged into hell, burned, stabbed, slashed … suffering all kinds of pain < third life >

Looking more broadly at all sentient beings who are suffering, whether human, animal, hungry ghost, or hell-being, all go through such cycles: doing good_receiving merit, simultaneously committing sins_enduring punishment.

But the time of suffering is often thousands of times longer than the time of enjoying blessings; it is truly a cruel and dangerous cycle. And this cycle of reincarnation is naturally like that; it is like a gigantic prison, imprisoning sentient beings with their own attachment to sensual pleasures, causing beings to suffer in endless succession, continuously without any way to break free.

Even the deities in the highest heavens of the formless realm, who enjoy the bliss of heaven for millions upon millions of years, still cannot escape this cruel cycle, let alone all of us?

But is there really no way to escape that vicious cycle? Fortunately for us—those who are connected with the Dharma—there is a way out!

The Buddha teaches us many methods to cultivate the Bodhi Mind, to plant the seeds of Enlightenment; these paths will gradually lead sentient beings out of the cycle of birth and death.

However, you must understand that you need to practice according to the true Dharma of the Buddha over countless lifetimes to hope to escape the vicious cycle of samsara. That is truly extremely difficult!

Even if in this life I encounter the Buddha's teachings, there is no guarantee that in the next life I will come across the true Dharma in the same way.

The Buddha, knowing this, out of compassion, taught an important principle, which He called "ARISING THE SUPREME BODHI MIND." In the Avatamsaka Sutra, it is referred to as "Initial Arising of the Mind," in the Diamond Sutra, it is called "Arising the Supreme Perfect Enlightenment Mind," and in some other sutras, it is called "Arising the Anuttara-samyak-sambodhi Mind."

Just a single instance of generating the SUPREME BODHICITTA, you and anyone else have already taken the first step on the solid, steadfast path toward Buddhahood. No matter what happens in countless future lifetimes, this will not change.

But what is GENERATING THE SUPREME BODHICITTA?

Like the vow of Mr. and Mrs. Trì Gia in the story, this is precisely GENERATING THE SUPREME BODHICITTA.

It is precisely because of making such a VOW that this person, after countless lifetimes of cultivation, will become a Buddha who saves countless sentient beings, as foretold to Buddha Shakyamuni.

In simple terms, ARISING THE MIND OF SUPREME BODHI is to develop the desire to become a Buddha and save all sentient beings. It's not difficult at all, right? And you can accomplish this today!

What you need to do is maintain reverence, step forward to the Buddha's altar, kneel down, press your hands together toward the Buddha, and make a vow (there are many ways to make vows; the following is just one way for reference):

“Namo Shakyamuni Buddha! Namo Amitabha Buddha! I sincerely dedicate all my wholesome roots and wholeheartedly vow that: in countless, infinite lifetimes to come, I will practice all virtuous deeds tirelessly until I attain Buddhahood like the Buddha, and save innumerable sentient beings throughout the Dharma realm! I humbly request the Buddhas of the ten directions to bear witness!”

And that wish will become even more sincere and effective if beforehand, you perform a meritorious deed like Mr. and Mrs. Trì Gia in the story of offering the Buddha a robe and a pure meal; we can give alms, make offerings, set beings free, print scriptures, or any other charitable act. Then, also kneel before the statue of the Buddha and pray saying:

“Namo Shakyamuni Buddha! Namo Amitabha Buddha! I sincerely dedicate all my virtues and this small merit, and earnestly pray that, with this small merit, in countless, limitless future lifetimes, I will practice all virtuous deeds endlessly until I attain Buddhahood like Him, and save innumerable beings in the Dharma realm! I humbly beseech all Buddhas of the ten directions to witness this!”

Every great giant tree starts from a tiny seedling. If you manage to do this, it means you have just sown a seed of the Bodhi tree into your cycle of birth and death. No matter how many lifetimes it takes, one thing is certain: your sacred vow will come true.

Of course, a person who has GENERATED THE SUPREME BODHI RESOLVE cannot immediately perform miracles. That person still has all the desires, anger, and ignorance; that person still often makes mistakes because of the ego. But those things will not have a chance to last long.

Like a person who has a compass within their heart, whether walking through dense forests or vast deserts, that person is not afraid of getting lost.

A person who has sown the seed of Bodhi in their heart always finds the right path to follow even without guidance. Even if a long time passes, having to go through more lifetimes than there are grains of sand on this Earth, it will not discourage that person.

Even in the face of difficulty and danger, having to sacrifice oneself for sentient beings, so many that they cover the surface of this Earth, it will not stop that person from moving forward.

The deities in the heavens continuously watch every step that person takes on the path leading to the Supreme Perfect Enlightenment. For that is the sacred path that the Buddhas of the ten directions have walked.

Be courageous and ARISE THE MIND OF SUPREME BODHI! That will be the greatest thing you have ever done in countless past lives and will open countless great things in countless future lives.

May you soon accomplish the Buddha Way!

Namo Shakyamuni Buddha!

Namo Amitabha Buddha!

Namo Great Compassionate Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva!

Namo Great Vow Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva!

Namo Future Maitreya Buddha!

"Sentient beings are limitless, vow to save them all.

Afflictions are endless, vow to eradicate them completely.

Dharma paths are boundless, vow to study and practice them.

The Buddha way is supreme, vow to accomplish it."

tieu_de: A LUSTFUL PERSON ALWAYS HAS A DEMON ABSORBING SEXUAL ENERGY FOLLOWING THEM
tom_tat: Ordinary people with lustful hearts always have energy-sucking demons following them. Lustful people, those with seminal emission or nocturnal emission, will attract demons that absorb vital energy because when one has lustful desires, it is like emitting waves similar to radio waves.
noi_dung:
SEXUALLY DRIVEN PEOPLE ALWAYS HAVE DEMONS THAT SUCK SPIRITUAL ENERGY FOLLOWING THEM

Ordinary people with lustful hearts always have spirits that absorb vital energy following them. Those who are lustful, suffer from involuntary seminal emission, or have nocturnal emissions will attract spirits that absorb vital energy. Because having lustful desires is like emitting waves similar to radio signals, spirits that absorb vital energy, upon catching this frequency, will follow you. These types of spirits that absorb vital energy make you their puppet, completely controlled by them. The spirits that absorb vital energy like lustful and immoral people the most; these spirits rely on such individuals to seize their vital energy for survival, using it as food. Suppose that several days pass without absorbing any vital energy,The demons will become sullen and exhausted, as if they are about to die. At this time, the demons will try to lead the thoughts of lustful people toward lust, causing that person to masturbate constantly or seek prostitutes to engage in sexual activities, eventually leading to the seduction of young girls and women to satisfy their desires. Because there are many energy-sucking demons around the person, these demons can long-term seize that person's vital energy, causing obstacles in their career, leading them further into degradation, and making them increasingly indulge in lust, reducing their blessings, and driving away benevolent spirits. The obstacles in that person's marriage are also caused by demons absorbing their vital energy.Think about it, a person who has a happy and perfect marriage will have a much lower chance of committing adultery, which is something evil spirits absolutely dislike. Otherwise, how would these demons continue to survive! In addition, an adulterous person with wrongful thoughts will immediately be abandoned by benevolent protective deities. Later on, illnesses will cling to the body, such as gynecological diseases or cancer; they will be deceived out of money, frequently get into car accidents, become involved in lawsuits, experience bad luck and misfortune, and after death, descend into Avici Hell.

Many people with particularly strong evil and lustful thoughts sometimes, while sleeping at night and dreaming, have demons that absorb vital energy transform into beautiful women to seduce them, causing that person to ejaculate in their dreams. Men dream of women and become aroused, women dream of men and engage in sexual thoughts; many people, even when reciting Buddha's name, will have lustful thoughts emerge.

CAUSE:

1. Insufficient merit: The reason people commit sexual misconduct is due to insufficient merit. The karmic force of sexual misconduct is so strong that they encounter evil friends and bad conditions (that teach them sexual misconduct, giving them opportunities to commit sexual misconduct), attracting a group of demons that drain vital essence, gradually depleting their merit.

2. Demons draining vital essence pulling the strings: These demons nearby incite us to commit sexual misconduct and manipulate our thoughts.

3. Protective benevolent spirits move away, or one cannot meet virtuous teachers, or even if encountered, one refuses to heed their guidance.

4. Insufficient vital energy: easily aroused sexual desire, sexual thoughts easily occur.

SOLUTION:

1. Increase merit: giving, observing precepts, patience, diligence, meditation, wisdom...

2. Recite Buddha's name, chant mantras, especially the Lankavatara Mantra, recite sutras, chant “Nam Mo Dai Tu Dai Bi Lien Hoa Ton Phong Nhu Lai” and “Nam Mo Vo U Toi Thang Cat Tuong Nhu Lai”. These are extremely effective Buddha names to control sexual desire.

3. Read more books that encourage goodness, observe celibacy precepts, and associate with virtuous friends.

4. Physical exercise, strengthening vital energy, repenting one's own mistakes

tieu_de: THE TERRIBLE CONSEQUENCES OF LUST, MODERN PEOPLE MUST UNDERSTAND
tom_tat: The ancients had a saying: "Of all the evils, lust is the greatest" (among all evils, the sin of lust ranks first), to say that committing the sin of lewdness will bring the heaviest retribution. A person, with just one lustful thought, can give rise to many evil thoughts, causing
noi_dung:
THE TERRIFYING CONSEQUENCES OF ADULTERY, MODERN PEOPLE MUST UNDERSTAND

The ancients had a saying: “Of all evils, sexual misconduct is the worst” (among all evils, the sin of lust ranks first), meaning that committing sins of sexual misconduct will bring the heaviest retribution.

A person, with just a thought of lust, can give rise to many evil thoughts, leading to shameless actions, harming others and violating moral principles, going against common ethics; from that, various evil deeds also arise.

The ancients believed that, as long as one commits sins of sexual misconduct, they are already accumulating heavy karma, thereby depleting blessings, and one's life path will consequently encounter many obstacles.

First of all, I would like to tell you more about what is committing fornication according to Buddhist teachings, which many people are very confused and difficult to understand today, and now let me list it for you to know, if you have mistakenly committed, you should also turn around and repent, and

definitely stop committing adultery:

1. Watching web movies, stories, sexual stimulation to propaganda and sharing of depraved cultural products

2. Masturbate and use assistive devices to masturbate, encourage masturbators to sell assistive devices for masturbation

3. Being in a cohabiting relationship like husband and wife before marriage, even if the two later get married, still reduces merit, let alone changing multiple lovers and having continuous relationships with many partners.

4. Sexual relations with someone who is not your husband or wife.

5. Married couples officially, but if they have sexual relations on the days of the ten taboos (1, 8, 14, 15, 18, 23, 24, 28, 29, 30 of the lunar calendar) and on the days honoring Buddha and Bodhisattvas (such as the day honoring Avalokiteshvara on 19.2, 19.4, 19.6, and the day honoring Kṣitigarbha on 30.7 of the lunar calendar), and if they use body parts other than the genitals for intercourse, or have relations in places other than the bedroom of the couple, it is also considered committing illicit sexual conduct. Many people, due to not understanding, experience bad luck in business if they engage in sexual relations with their spouse, because it is considered committing illicit sexual conduct.

Below are 13 terrifying consequences of illicit sexual conduct:

1. LOSS OF BLESSINGS

Severely depleting one's karmic blessings, the status and wealth that a person should have will also diminish accordingly. Some people have quite good Bazi charts, but their real life does not go as expected, often because they commit acts of filial impiety or sexual misconduct, depleting their own blessings. If we say a person's blessings are like a barrel, then sexual misconduct is like a hole at the bottom of the barrel, no matter how much blessing there is, it will all leak out. Especially nowadays, websites and movies are flooded with content of lust and perversion, profoundly affecting people's minds and causing great depletion of blessings.again quickly. In this internet era, accumulating blessings is easy, but creating karma is even easier.

2. DAMAGE TO NOBLE MORALITY

Those who are immoral do not have noble qualities, are often despised by others, and wherever they go, they make others look down on them.

3. UNFAVORABLE WORK

Work encounters numerous obstacles; even if some tasks seem close to success, they will fail due to immorality, often failing in inexplicable ways.

4. CONSTANT FEAR

Lacking self-confidence, having no righteous spirit, not daring to face superiors, not daring to enter temples or shrines, afraid of ghosts and deities, afraid of the dark, timid and cowardly.

5. DAMAGE TO HUMAN SPIRITUALITY

Poor memory, poor ability to absorb information, forgetting everything in the blink of an eye; the mind is not clear, dazed and confused, weak learning ability, poor reasoning and judgment skills. Leading to particularly severe insomnia, even causing mental problems.

6. DESTROYING BEAUTY

Hair is dry and yellow, grays early, skin looks poor, ages quickly.

7. PHYSICAL EXHAUSTION

Body functions are weak, feeling sluggish without energy, unable to lift the spirit, poor resistance to illness, easily falling sick. Weak vital energy, feeling aches and pains after walking just a few steps.

8. DISEASES ALL OVER THE BODY

Immorality will invite sexually transmitted diseases. Sexually transmitted diseases are different from other illnesses; most are related to immorality and drugs, and very rarely occur without reason. Ultimately, they are connected with an impure mind, even if one does not have overnight encounters with prostitutes, they are still related to other immoral behaviors. If one engages in too many immoral acts, safety measures cannot protect against them, and unforeseen events always occur. Some sexually transmitted diseases are very difficult to treat, and in some cases, may never be cured for life.

Of course, if you unfortunately get it, it doesn't mean there's absolutely no way. "All things in the world" arise from the mind; the illness you contract is closely related to that mind. Sexual diseases are related to immoral sexual behavior. If one can sincerely repent and completely abandon immoral sexual behavior in actions, words, and thoughts, then this illness will be easier to cure.

9. LOSS OF BLESSINGS IN MARRIAGE

Immorality leads to a serious depletion of marital fortune and attracts relatives who are not as desired. Everything is predestined. Before marriage, indulging oneself and depleting too much marital fortune will result in marrying a partner who is difficult to meet expectations. You may attribute it to incompatible personalities, but this is a superficial reason; in reality, the fundamental cause is that your fortune has been excessively depleted. Fortune in this aspect is too thin, so marriage naturally cannot be happy.

After getting married, engaging in immoral activities, no matter how well hidden, will inevitably cause problems in the marital relationship. People with heavy karma in this aspect, whether slightly or severely, will lead to various types of disharmony in the marriage, up to different kinds of conflicts. People with little blessing in this aspect will immediately face a fractured marriage.

10. THE NEXT LIFE DOES NOT GO AS DESIRED

Firstly, it easily invites the consequence of infertility. People who engage excessively in immoral sexual activities or work in immoral sexual professions have a higher rate of infertility compared to ordinary people. Secondly, it can easily result in weak bodies for the next generation, with no bright future, and may even cause rebellious children.

11. ABORTION

Abortion is a serious karma of killing, with the most direct retribution being harm to physical health, causing problems in male-female relationships. Many people who have had abortions recognize that after an abortion, it is often very easy for issues to arise in relationships with their partners or spouses, leading to discord, arguments, and even separation, etc. This is just the beginning; more severe retribution awaits in the future.

12. INVITING DISASTER

When murder cases occur, the first things the police think about are whether they are related to hatred, emotions, or money? Immorality has always been one of the most important causes for solving crimes. We can also feel this in our daily lives. After committing immoral acts, losing money frequently in gambling, being prone to car accidents, it seems that we encounter all kinds of misfortunes.

13. IN THE NEXT LIFE, FALL INTO THE THREE EVIL PATHS

Ordinary-hearted people ascend lightly to the heavenly realm, evil-hearted people fall heavily into hell, and those who attain the Way transcend reincarnation. People controlled by lust exhibit extremely strong evil hearts, and falling into the evil path is an inevitable result.
