tieu_de: Answering questions about the method of reciting the Great Compassion Mantra and achieving benefits that are beyond imagination
tom_tat: The Great Compassion Mantra was taught by Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, out of compassion for all sentient beings, wishing for them to be happy, to be free from all illnesses, to live long, to be wealthy, and to eliminate all evil karma and sins.
noi_dung:
ANSWERING QUESTIONS ABOUT HOW TO RECITE THE GREAT COMPASSION MANTRA AND TO ACHIEVE IMMEASURABLE BENEFITS

The Great Compassion Mantra was spoken by Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara, out of compassion for all beings, wishing that beings may be happy, free from all illnesses, live long, be wealthy, eliminate all heavy karmic offenses, be distant from obstacles and dangers, accomplish all good roots, dispel all fears, and quickly fulfill all their wishes. Therefore, he taught this mantra. From ancient times until now, many people have recited it and all have attained immeasurable benefits. However, there are some who recite it but still do not receive the benefits as desired. For this reason, todayQuang Tu will share with you the way to recite the Great Compassion Mantra correctly according to the method taught by Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva in the Great Compassion Dharani Sutra.

First, the person chanting the mantra must satisfy the following conditions:

1. Being someone who observes the Five Precepts is ideal, and practicing the Ten Virtuous Deeds is even better. The extent to which one observes the Five Precepts is also an important factor that determines the efficacy of the mantra (especially refraining from killing and sexual misconduct). Regarding the precepts, you are likely already very familiar, so Quang Tu will not repeat them. If you still eat meat, only the meat of the three purified types may be consumed, and you must avoid the five pungent vegetables (scallions, chives, garlic, shallots, leeks) and brush and rinse your mouth thoroughly before chanting the mantra.

2. One must have deep and firm faith in the mantra, because in the sutra, Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva said: “Beings who recite this mantra will have all the ten evil acts, the five heinous crimes, blasphemy, harming others, breaking precepts, violating the precepts, destroying temples and stupas, stealing from monks, defiling moral conduct—all such severe karmic offenses—completely eliminated, except for one thing: if the person reciting the mantra still harbors doubts. If such a mind arises, even minor sins and light karmic offenses cannot be removed, let alone severe sins. But although severe sins may not be immediately eradicated, it can create the seed of bodhi in future lifetimes.” Therefore, even if one only has a little doubt, such as "If I recite the mantra, will it really..."Cured of illness?", "If I chant the mantra, will I really get what I wish for?" — surely it will not manifest. You must understand that when you chant the mantra and it does not work, it means that your karma is still very heavy, and your mind has not attained sincere dedication, so persistence in practice is necessary. When your karma lightens, then what you wish for will become reality! Usually, after a few months, you will feel the effect; if your karma is very heavy, then at the latest within 3 years, if you persist without missing a single day and chant the mantra daily, you will surely have a great response! In addition, it is also necessary to see whether you are a virtuous man or woman as described in the scriptures.say no (that is, knowing how to keep the five precepts and practice the ten wholesome deeds). Although you may not be a virtuous man or virtuous woman as mentioned in the sutras, thanks to the compassionate power of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, as long as you have deep and firm faith in his mantra, he will also bless you to achieve success.

3. How should one cultivate the mind when chanting the mantra? In the sutra, Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva speaks to the Great Heavenly King Brahma about the form and appearance of the Great Compassion Mantra, saying: “Oh King Brahma! The minds of great compassion, equanimity, non-doing, non-attachment, unobservant mind, reverent mind, humble mind, undisturbed mind, non-grasping mind, unsurpassed Bodhi mind – one should know that all these minds are the forms of this dharani. Therefore, you should practice accordingly…”. Hence, in order for the mantra to be effective, we must possess at least one of these kinds of mind, although it is very difficult for ordinary beings. However, minds such as: a reverent mindrespectful, humble (modest, not arrogant, reverent toward virtuous teachers, masters, and filial to parents); mind without attachment (not covetous of blessings and treasures); equanimous mind (toward all beings, cultivating an equal heart), great compassionate mind (caring for all beings, whether a single ant or even a mosquito)… We can do it!

4. When chanting mantras, is it necessary to have a Buddha altar? Can one chant silently without vocalizing? Is it permissible to chant in the bathroom?.....When chanting mantras, as long as there is a clean and solemn place, one can sit and chant; it is acceptable to chant while walking, responding, lying down, or sitting. However, if lying down or sitting in unclean places such as the bathroom, one must chant mentally and not vocalize because doing so would be disrespectful! The only exception is during marital relations, when chanting is not allowed! When chanting mantras, it is best that if there is no altar, one should wear clean clothing, brush their teeth for freshness, and most importantly, avoid consuming strong-flavored spices (becauseEating these types (the guardian spirits will stay away, chanting mantras will not be effective) then find a solemn and clean place to chant is fine, circumstances may change, of course the most important thing is still your reverent heart!

5. How to dedicate merit in the most complete way according to the Dharma? The sutras say that one must generate a great vow to save all sentient beings and must have an equanimous mind, a non-attachment mind, and a mind of great compassion. Therefore, first, you should make a great vow such as "May I, in all future lives, assist Avalokiteshvara in guiding all sentient beings to Buddhahood" or "May I attain Buddhahood soon to guide countless sentient beings." Each person's vow may be different, and if you can dedicate the merit of your practice and recitation of the Great Compassion Mantra to all sentient beings in the Dharma realm, always wishing that all sentient beings beA great benefit that does not seek anything for oneself, not coveting merit and blessings, and dedicating all the merit and blessings attained to all beings, reciting mantras out of compassion and mercy for all beings, while also being a good man or good woman, whatever you wish for—even if you only think about it in your mind—they will help you achieve it! And surely you will obtain the 15 types of auspicious births and never encounter the 15 types of inauspicious deaths as mentioned in the Sutra. This is called achieving without seeking, seeking without asking!

The benefits obtained from persistently chanting the Great Compassion mantra:

In the Great Compassion Dharani Sutra, Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara said to the Buddha: "Oh, World-Honored One! If beings of heaven and humans chant the Great Compassion mantra, they will not suffer 15 kinds of bad deaths and will obtain 15 good rebirths. What are the 15 kinds of bad deaths?

1. Not dying from extreme hunger or thirst.

2. Not dying from imprisonment and beatings.

3. Not dying due to enemies or adversaries.

4. Not to die amid armies battling and killing each other.

5. Not to die due to tigers, wolves, and other ferocious beasts.

6. Not to die from the bite of venomous snakes.

7. Not to die from floods or fire.

8. Not to die from exposure to poison.

9. Not to die from harmful poisonous worms or insects.

10. Not to die due to madness or delirium.

11. Not to die from falling trees or falling off mountains.

12. Not to die by evil people casting spells.

13. Not to die from being harmed by evil gods or demons.

14. Not to die from severe illness.

15. Not to die by self-inflicted accidents.

Reciting the Great Compassion Mantra will prevent death from these 15 unfortunate causes.

What is called the 15 good places of birth?

1. Depending on the place of birth, often meet wise and kind kings.

2. Depending on the place of birth, often dwell in a peaceful country.

3. Depending on the place of birth, one often encounters a favorable era,

4. Depending on the place of birth, one often meets good friends.

5. Depending on the place of birth, the body is often well-developed.

6. Depending on the place of birth, the mind of the path is pure and mature.

7. Depending on the place of birth, one does not violate moral precepts.

8. Depending on the place of birth, relatives are often harmonious, affectionate, and faithful.

9. Depending on the place of birth, utensils and food are often sufficient.

10. Depending on the place of birth, one is often helped by respectful people.

11. Depending on the place of birth, money and treasures are not taken by others.

12. Depending on the place of birth, all desires are fulfilled.

13. Depending on the place of birth, dragons, deities, and benevolent spirits often support.

14. Depending on the place of birth, one often sees the Buddha and listens to the Dharma.

15. Depending on the place of birth, when listening to the true Dharma, one deeply understands its meaning.

If any sentient being in this present life wishes to seek something, they should observe strict moral precepts for 21 days and recite the Great Compassion Mantra, and all will be fulfilled. If one sincerely and regularly recites it, from one life and death to another, all negative karma will quickly be eliminated. All Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, Brahma, Indra, the Four Heavenly Kings, spirits, immortals, and dragon kings will all bear witness. Beings, humans or heavenly, who regularly uphold this mantra with devotion are like bathing in rivers, lakes, or the sea; if other beings in those waters come into contact with the bathing water of such a person, all their heavy and sinful karma will be completely destroyed, immediately attainingBeing reborn in the Pure Land of other places, transforming to be born on a lotus flower, no longer taking birth in womb, egg, or moist germ. Beings like these can achieve such a state merely through a slight influence, let alone the person who recites and upholds it? And, for example, if a person recites a mantra while walking on the road, and a gust of wind passes by them, if the beings behind are touched by the wind from that person, all their evil karma and heavy obstructions will entirely be destroyed, and they will no longer fall into the three lower realms, always being born before the Buddhas. Therefore, it should be known that the karmic rewards and blessings of the person who recites and upholds mantras are truly beyond comprehension!

Up until now, Quang Tu, by following the above practices, has used the Great Compassion Mantra to pray, and whatever he wished for has been fulfilled. Now he wishes to share with everyone that the merits and benefits of the Great Compassion Mantra are beyond imagination. In this degenerate age, if you encounter this dharma practice and overlook it, it is like coming to a golden mountain and returning empty-handed. No matter how great the upcoming calamity may be, if you sincerely uphold the Great Compassion Mantra, you will surely always be safe. Below is the ritual of mantra recitation that Quang Tu continues to practice daily, which he wishes to share with everyone for reference!

tieu_de: In times of danger, one should chant the name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva
tom_tat: Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara has great virtue, power, and compassion. He was not originally a female figure, but because he often saves beings from suffering and calamity (and women often experience more suffering and calamity than men)
noi_dung:
MOMENTS OF DANGER WHEN ONE SHOULD RECITE THE NAME OF BODHISATTVA QUAN THE AM

Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara possesses great authority and compassion. Originally, He was not female, but because He often saves beings from suffering and disaster (and women typically experience more suffering and disaster compared to men), the female realm especially venerates Him. Thus, beings imagined Him as female to facilitate salvation for women. Therefore, Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara embodies the virtue of Compassion, expressing the maternal love of a mother for her child, the sincerest and most ardent love, unmatched by any other. Avalokitesvara manifests as a kind mother to humanity,the benefit of all sentient beings. Quang Tu himself is a person who has received great blessings from Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva. In the early days of embarking on the path, it was Avalokiteshvara who guided Quang Tu, helping him meet good teachers and virtuous friends, allowing him to be where he is today. Therefore, today Quang Tu will show everyone how to recite the name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva in times of danger and how to chant the six-syllable great bright mantra of Avalokiteshvara.

Of course, first of all, once you are a devoted Buddhist, in order to deeply resonate with the Bodhisattvas, you must definitely observe the precepts, at least the Five Precepts! Every day, you should frequently recite their name, and it doesn't need to be too many times; just 108 times is sufficient (Namo Great Compassionate Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva). If anyone is already accustomed to reciting the Great Compassion Mantra or the Six-Syllable Mantra (Om mani pad me hum), even better, because it makes it easier to resonate with the Bodhisattva. It's like when you regularly visit or stay in touch with someone, then when you need help, that person will be willing and enthusiastic to assist you. Of course, Avalokiteshvara is very compassionate, even if youWhether or not one recites His name daily, in times of danger, if you recite His name, He will still come to save you; the only difference is that it is not the same as those who daily respectfully recite His name or practice His mantras! When in an urgent situation, please put your hands together respectfully (or, if it is inconvenient to do so, you can recite it silently) and recite His name with reverence and utmost urgency, while thinking about the matter that is causing you suffering and worry. As long as you are sincere, you can be sure that He will use many means to help you!

QT himself has always recited the six-syllable great bright mantra and the great compassion mantra daily, and the power of these mantras is beyond imagination, in work as well as in life in all fields... including technology, machinery, or working with superiors... in difficult and worrying moments, QT would recite his name and would be blessed to resolve everything smoothly and without worry, usually just 1-2 minutes after that ^^, so everyone can be confident that success is certain!

Furthermore, if someone recites the name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva throughout their entire life, they can still be reborn in the Western Pure Land at the end of their life, provided that the person achieves either non-thought, self-recollection, or single-minded concentration without confusion!

As for the Great Bright Six-Syllable Mantra, in the Mahayana Sutra of the Adorned Treasure King, Buddha Shakyamuni said that it took him 1 million kalpas to find this mantra. He also said: I can know how many raindrops fall on the Earth in a year, how many grains of sand are in the Ganges, but I cannot fully describe the power of this mantra. This is a mantra of immense power ..., with some great benefits such as:

1. Mantras are the manifestation of the language and intellectual capacity of all Buddhas. They are a means to protect the mind from deluded thoughts, cut off ignorance, and open wisdom. They increase immeasurable blessings and allow us to achieve peace. This mantra can help and soothe hundreds and thousands of sufferings and miseries of sentient beings.

2. Furthermore, in this very life, simply reciting OM MANI PAD ME HUM will dispel illnesses, ailments, and various spirits, and one will become happy, peaceful, and fulfilled.

3. Reciting this mantra will enhance the power of meditation and develop deeper levels of meditation in this life, which will continue in many future lives.

4. Regularly reciting the mantra, at the time of death, one will not be born into the three lower realms but will be reborn in the Western Pure Land or in the Pure Land of Avalokiteshvara – Riwo Potala, and there, will gradually attain Buddhahood. Until that time, the blessings and power of the practice will not be exhausted; it will continue to bring the results of enlightenment.

5. Reciting the mantra can increase blessings and make all wishes come true.

For some people, the sound of this mantra is unimaginable, but few know that Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva had to make vows and accumulate immeasurable merit, wisdom, and skillful means to create this mantra in order to help sentient beings.

Like the great compassion mantra, in order to recite it, you must first have a deep and firm faith in the mantra, without any doubt, and cultivate a sense of reverence; in this way, there will be many benefits. You should recite the mantra every day, at least 108 times/day. While traveling or doing household chores, you can also recite it as you go about your tasks. The first thing you will certainly notice after some time is that your life will become extremely favorable. If you persist, many wonderful things will continue to happen to you, and even your most secret wishes, which you do not express, will come true because I have experienced it, so I know this to be true.In addition, the mantra has the ability to eliminate karma and rapidly increase blessings. Reciting the mantra can also help you be reborn in the blissful realm of Amitabha Buddha!

Therefore, we should respectfully recite the name of Avalokiteshvara, and sincerely and clearly chant the Six-Syllable Great Bright Mantra every day. In this way, all your worldly and transcendent needs will be fulfilled…

tieu_de: PEOPLE INFECTED WITH THE CORONA COVID VIRUS BEING IGNORED?
tom_tat: Usually, anyone who gets the disease COVID is considered as if their household has been sentenced to death. It's true, just hearing the name makes everyone tremble. Just hearing the name COVID makes everyone scared, let alone being caught up in it.
noi_dung:
PEOPLE MISSED BY THE COVID CORONA VIRUS?

Usually, anyone who catches the disease COVID is considered as if their household is sentenced to death. Seriously, just hearing the name makes everyone tremble. Just hearing the name COVID scares everyone, let alone actually getting infected. Yet in my family of four, three of us got it, and only I was the exception who didn't get it, which is strange. My friend was teasing me yesterday, saying I must be from outer space. Hihihi...

Perhaps people don't believe and think that I am making this up for views or that I am lying to make people curious.... No, I am not crazy enough to report the death of my entire family for fun. I tell this with honesty, I never lie, God and Buddha are my witnesses. And I always share Buddhist teachings daily to give to you. I remind you to always gargle with salt water twice a day to prevent illness.

Moreover, it has been more than a month since November 16, 2020, and now it is already the beginning of December 2020. I had to stay home and isolate with my family for everyone's sake. Everyone in the house and I got tested at a hospital in Sacramento, California. We thought the world's deadliest disease would kill us, but not at all; my whole family went through an illness similar to a mild flu. They just took a few Tylenol and that was it. As for me, I am still perfectly fine living with the bunch, and the covid virus didn't bother with me because my body is too tough to touch even until now. Strange, isn't it?

I, a child of Buddha, am under the protection of guardian deities. When I studied Buddhism and recited the Kṣitigarbha Sutra, I then realized that Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva had firmly declared: If any virtuous man or faithful woman recites or transcribes the Kṣitigarbha Sutra, or even just praises it, then in the present life and in future lives, they will often be protected day and night by hundreds of thousands of spirits, without those spirits allowing misfortunes to come to them, let alone causing unexpected calamities. Every intention of ours is accompanied by spirits, devas, humans and non-humans, and guardian deities, who, having lost their human bodies, rely on our recitation of the Buddha's name to save them from disasters.

in hell and guide them to the Buddha. For that reason, they will support that person, preventing any misfortune from happening to a Buddhist like me. I believe and firmly believe in miracles.

This article demonstrates to you that if we sow good seeds, we will encounter good things. Good people should use a kind heart to encourage others to do beneficial deeds and to perpetuate the teachings of the Buddha, so as not to disappoint Śākyamuni Buddha and Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha, who for our sake did not attain Buddhahood. The miraculous stories I told previously in my home are entirely true. If anyone has not read them, they should read them to be informed. Believe that in any era there are always Buddhas present to help us when we remember them. Thank you for reading.

The lesson drawn here is that, whether we go through any difficult or favorable circumstances, we can always transform those circumstances into an opportunity for self-cultivation, a practical teaching that deserves to be respectfully practiced. No matter the circumstances, remember not to stray from the Dharma. Hopefully, this article will be a meaningful piece for you to deepen your faith.

Dedication: May whatever I do in this life be sincerely dedicated to the Western Pure Land of the Buddha, and may all merit be dedicated to the higher benevolent spirits, my ancestors and parents of many generations, to my karmic enemies, and to all sentient beings throughout the Dharma realm, so that they may be reborn in the Pure Land. May I, at the time of leaving this body, receive the vow of Amitabha Buddha. May I always express love and always spread the Dharma of the Buddha everywhere to save sentient beings still trapped in suffering.

Buddhist practitioner: Alisa

Namo Amitabha Buddha 📷📷📷

Source: Earth Store Bodhisattva

--------------------------------------

In the Sutra of Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows, there is mention of the King of Disease Ghosts, and all epidemics in the world are carried out by this Ghost King according to the requirements of the Underworld, and those who die from epidemics are already listed. However, those who practice vegetarianism and recite the Buddha's name will certainly not die from epidemics, those who sincerely chant the Great Compassion Mantra or take refuge and respectfully venerate Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva will also not encounter accidents, let alone die from such epidemics! The above story is an example; esteemed practitioners, please pay attention and do not neglect it!

tieu_de: Venerable Thích Tịnh Không is not necessarily a reincarnated person
tom_tat: Venerable Master Tịnh Không said: nowadays the number of incarnations of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas in this world is really too many, too many, the holy and the secular are together like dragons and snakes mixed, yet sentient beings are not easily guided and are truly far behind.
noi_dung:
VENERABLE TỊNH KHÔNG IS NOT NECESSARILY A REINCARNATED PERSON

Venerable Master Tịnh Không said: Nowadays, the number of incarnations of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas in this world is truly very, very many. The holy and mundane are together like dragons and snakes mixed, yet sentient beings are not easily saved, falling far short compared to people of the past; people in the past were simple and much easier to guide than modern people.

Nowadays, most of the famous virtuous teachers are reincarnations of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas: Mr. Ha Lien Cu, who compiled the Infinite Life Sutra, is Samantabhadra Bodhisattva; Mr. Hoang Niem To, who wrote the commentary on the Infinite Life Sutra, is Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva; Han Guan, who was the Dharma protector for Venerable Master Jingkong for 30 years, is Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva; Venerable Master Xuan Hua is also Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva; the lay elder Li Binh Nam is also a reincarnate; the two former teachers of Master Jingkong, Mr. Phuong Dong My and Grand Master Chuong Gia, were also no ordinary people. In the past, Empress Dowager Cixi of the Qing Dynasty was a disciple who took refuge with Grand Master Chuong Gia, the founding patriarch of the Japanese Pure Land school.

Venerable Pháp Nhiên Thượng Nhân is Mahāsthāmaprāpta Bodhisattva, the First and Second Patriarchs of the Vietnamese Pure Land School; Venerable Trí Tịnh is Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva; Venerable Thiền Tâm is Mahāsthāmaprāpta Bodhisattva; the Venerable Huỳnh, the Founder of Hòa Hảo Buddhism in Vietnam, is also not an ordinary person... up to the 13 Patriarchs of the Chinese Pure Land School, most were reincarnated beings, such as Venerable Thiện Đạo, Venerable Vĩnh Minh who was Amitabha Buddha, Venerable Triệt Lưu who was Venerable Hám Sơn reborn, Venerable Ấn Quang who is Mahāsthāmaprāpta Bodhisattva... We know these individuals were reincarnated because Venerable Tịnh Không knew and spoke about it, along with some special conditions, such as people with special cultivation or abilities being revealed, or the Venerables themselves.After passing away, he manifested a dream to inform everyone. There is also this person who, after being exposed, revealed another person; whenever anyone reveals, they will immediately leave, it is absolutely not false... It is all for the purpose of demonstrating and increasing our faith. As for the number of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas who reincarnate without our detection, it is countless. We must respect everyone because anyone we meet could be a Buddha or Bodhisattva, just like Master Han Son, Thap Dac, and Phong Can at Quoc Thanh Temple, who performed arduous tasks in the temple that few valued, yet they were actually Manjushri, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, and Amitabha Buddha. Only afterwards did people realize their mistakes.with the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas...

Nowadays, there are too many Bodhisattvas, not only appearing consecutively but also simultaneously in the same era. Their incarnations are everywhere, yet ordinary people find it difficult to recognize them because of their compassionate intent to save and relieve sentient beings who are about to encounter numerous great calamities. Anyone who listens extensively to Venerable Master Jingkong's Dharma talks, especially in the Sutra of Ten Wholesome Deeds, the Infinite Life Sutra, and the Exposition on the Amitabha Sutra, will frequently hear terms such as: accidents, natural disasters, man-made calamities, doomsday, the end of the world, world chaos, world destruction,... repeated many times. Scientific and technological development has reached a certain levelIt is destined to lead to a world of destruction, causing people's hearts to grow in greed, hatred, and ignorance, injustice... which will attract disasters such as floods, fires, storms, earthquakes... Not only Buddhists, but many religions and ancient prophecies have warned about the end of the world, and even extraterrestrial beings have come to Earth to warn us. In the book series encouraging goodness, Âm Luật Vô Tình, there are also details that mention and reveal this issue. If the evil influences of the human world continue to increase like this, they will certainly bring about natural disasters and human calamities, which other religions usually refer to as 'God's reckoning.' The movie2012, The Year of Great Calamity, is a warning bestowed upon us by the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas. If accidents occur, they might resemble what happens in movies; by that time, about two-thirds of the world's population could perish, leaving only just over one billion people in the post-disaster world. Many years ago, the Ebola outbreak became a global terror, causing countless people to die in painful illness and extreme fear. Venerable Master Jingkong publicly told everyone that this disaster was caused by the effects of malicious hearts filled with greed, anger, ignorance, pride, and doubt... acting simultaneously, at which time humans could not find any way to mitigate it except to pray for it to end soon. Very few people...Understanding this, by this time humans have even created the Coronavirus out of ambitious greed for domination, spreading terror across the world. Scientists have also issued warnings that if the global temperature rises by just one more degree, this planet will no longer be suitable for human habitation. Today, industrial and agricultural emissions continue to increase, forest fires are rampant due to deforestation for economic purposes... especially the world's largest Amazon rainforest has been continuously burning in recent times, making the rise in global temperature almost inevitable. Nowadays, Buddhas and Bodhisattvas appear frequently in the world to help sentient beings.Take time to prepare the mind and provisions in order to quickly migrate to the Land of Ultimate Bliss, just as Master Từ Vân Quán Đảnh said: the most serious karmic offenses of all sentient beings are so deep that even all penitential practices cannot eliminate them, yet a single recitation of 'Amitabha Buddha' can eradicate them. Layman Lý Bỉnh Nam said: there is only one path to life, which is to recite Buddha's name and aspire to be born in the Pure Land. Venerable Tịnh Không said that both Master Quán Đảnh and Layman Lý Bỉnh Nam are people of past lives. Grand Master Ấn Quang also very much lamented, saying: "Advise to leave early from many kalpas of suffering, together walk towards the Western Pure Land." Master Thiện Đạo said: "There is only a shortcut to liberation, just recite 'Amitabha Buddha'."Grandpa Ha Lien Cu said: "If you want to know how to cross the River of Desire, you must recite Amitabha to the maximum." Nowadays, "If you want to escape the suffering of samsara, you must urgently recite Amitabha." "Crossing back and forth through the three paths and six realms, if you want to pass, you must recite Amitabha." "Considering the world and the beyond forever, if you don't recite Amitabha, then who should you recite?" Now there is only one phrase, 'Amitabha Buddha,' that can save us. Currently, those figures have all passed away, and we are left with only one Elder Master Tinh Khong, over 94 years old, who is using all his strength every day to save sentient beings. We just fear that after he passes away, disaster will come to us very quickly. His ability to remain in the world for any additional day is the blessing of merit.Our kind. Although accidents are not truly here yet, just look at how many people die from traffic accidents every day... etc., how many people undergo abortions, killing their own children. Just the number of aborted fetuses is already greater than the total global population. The total number of species in the sky, on land, or under water that humans have killed is really countless. This is very worthy of our vigilance. Living one day, we need to stop doing evil, practice good, and try to recite the Buddha's name for a day, and there is nothing more peaceful than that. Venerable Master Jingkong teaches: For those who recite the Buddha's name, an accident coming is a good thing because we have the opportunity to rely on the Buddha's name and quickly be reborn in the Pure Land.When others, in moments of panic, mostly fall into evil paths. And in collective karma, there is also individual karma; if you have a kind heart and do many good deeds with great blessings, you will have superior individual karma, and you will be on the list of those who escape disasters to continue practicing and chanting Buddha.

Venerable Hai Hien, who fulfilled the role of Dharma demonstrator for us, has also passed away, leaving behind his entire relics. Venerable Hai Hien and Venerable Jingkong, although they never met, understood each other very well and worked together perfectly to save sentient beings to the Western Pure Land. Venerable Jingkong clearly knew that Elder Venerable Hai Hien had long been practicing Buddha recitation to the point of single-minded, undisturbed focus; his level was no less than Sixth Patriarch Huineng or the eminent monks of the Tang dynasty. But because he served as a Dharma demonstrator, he lived to 112 years old. Venerable Jingkong is still strongly recommending Elder Venerable Hai Hien to be the 14th Patriarch of the Pure Land School, hoping that his example...may benefit countless future sentient beings

Venerable Hai Hien also clearly knows the identity of Venerable Ting Kong but cannot explicitly tell us because if the Buddha or Bodhisattva's identity is revealed, they will immediately leave the world. However, in his words, Venerable Hai Hien has a very profound statement: diligently recite the Buddha's name, reciting the Buddha's name is real while everything else is false. Venerable Ting Kong is here to teach the Sutra to welcome us to the Pure Land. This is a very encouraging statement for us; thus, Venerable Ting Kong is very likely a reincarnated Being. But we also need, like Venerable Hai Hien, to not dare to explicitly discuss or reveal his true identity.Because he feared that he would soon pass away, as long as they faithfully followed his teachings, he would remain in the world for a long time.

Therefore, nowadays when we encounter someone who slanders Master Tịnh Không and the Pure Land Dharma practice, we should not be angry with them but feel compassion for them, because they are the most pitiable sentient beings in the ten directions of the world. We can recognize what true treasures are, while they, even if they come across precious things, throw them into the mud; although they share the same human body and meeting, some achieve liberation from birth and death, while others have to fall into the greatest suffering in Avici Hell. This misfortune is their own.

A DI ĐÀ PHẬT

PLEASE CHANT FREQUENTLY

❤️ Hurry and recite Amitabha Buddha

❤️ The homeland is extremely blissful, with father waiting

tieu_de: THE TIME GOING DOWN TO VISIT HELL
tom_tat: (A true story in Hue, with the person's name and specific address) Do you believe that there exists a realm — full of mystery and horror, called by a name that just mentioning it makes everyone shiver: HELL?
noi_dung:
THE TIME GOING DOWN TO VISIT HELL

(A true story in Hue, with specific names and addresses)

Do you believe that there exists a realm – full of mystery and horror, called by a name that when mentioned makes everyone shudder: HELL?

I am Hoàng Minh Thắng, living in Vĩnh Lưu village, Phú Lương, Phú Vang, Thừa Thiên Huế, born in 1989. The following story may make you skeptical, confused, or afraid, but for me - it is a real experience, one I will never be able to forget in my life; it profoundly changed my worldview. And above all, it taught me to live kindly and to appreciate every moment of meaningful life as a human being.

I frequently experience sleep paralysis, and there are times when I clearly see those images, sometimes it's a soldier, sometimes it's a girl... But since I am originally a math major and now work for the government in a scientific field, I consider the phenomenon of sleep paralysis to be a scientific phenomenon and do not feel fear or have any particular thoughts about it.

But everything began to change from that time:

Around August 2017, as usual, I experienced sleep paralysis again. This time it was still the girl I often saw in previous episodes. Usually, she would just stand next to me, advising me on moral and proper things – I thought she was a religious person. But this time was different; she, along with another middle-aged man, led me to a place...

At that place, initially, both sides of the road were lined with red and withered yellow flowers. They said these were la-lan flowers and sa-dec flowers. Upon closer inspection, the flowers had five sharp petals and looked very strange.

Then we went to a small bridge and met a woman. She said this was the Underworld and informed me that this Saturday, someone in my family would pass away.

Walking past the flower-filled path, there was a river, along its banks were huge chains, as big as a 60kg man.

Then I met a large group of people who said they were dead; some said they wanted to go with me, others threatened me, and a few recognized that I was not yet dead — these people thought that I must have a great "divine aura" to still be alive and have descended here, but more than anyone, I knew that I had a guide who protected me to be able to come here.

Suddenly, I was brought back to the living world and woke up, and lingering in my mind were the words of that girl, reminding me to practice...

Perhaps everything I would consider a bizarre dream, if it weren't for this incident.

Sure enough, that Saturday a member of my family passed away, just as the woman had foretold. This made my worldview collapse; I thought a lot and gradually realized that there are other worlds in existence, not just this material world.

After that first time, in March 2018, once again, that girl led me...

I was led to a very crowded area, but this time the scene was truly terrifying, people piled up on each other, bobbing up and down, writhing on a surface made entirely of fire—looking closer, it was molten lava boiling violently. Oh heavens, normal fire already burns painfully, how excruciating must molten lava be?!

While I was still in shock, a hand grabbed me, pulling my legs down. So scared, all I could do was chant Buddha's name repeatedly. Miraculously, an invisible force held me back; they could not pull me down into that sea of fire.

I immediately ran very fast and reached an area. Here, there were drinking tables, with many people sitting around them. But this is hell, so the tables are not like those in the earthly world; there is beer but it cannot be drunk. No one is beaten, but they spin themselves to the point of madness. They pull their hair, scratch their ears, writhing in extreme pain... and beside them, I saw a very clear sign that read "Sin of using alcohol and addictive substances".

I continued walking and came to a very small and difficult hanging bridge. I chanted "Nam Mô A Di Đà Phật," the bridge swayed, but I eventually managed to cross it. As soon as I got to the other side, I was struck by the sight of a very beautiful Western woman, wearing a blue dress, plump with sensuous white skin.

She was attacked by a fierce-faced monster, with a human body but a wolf's face. It threw a spear through her body, pinning her to the wall, a truly horrifying sight.

I asked and was told that she was being executed for committing adultery and killing her husband. I blurted out, "What a pity, don't do that..."

The demon immediately turned and stared at me, with a ferocity I had never seen before; just looking at it made me feel my soul leave my body:

- You will meet the same fate!

“Whack” the demon beheaded her and threw her to the ground, pointing and shouting: “Crime of adultery!”

Terrified, I jolted awake, yet her words reminding me to reform myself still echoed in my mind... The retribution for the crime of adultery is deadly, humans are truly terrifying! I swear to change myself, never daring to commit this sin again!

After that horrifying experience, after some time had passed, the following year, around March 2019, I was once again pressed down heavily while sleeping, and then I felt like I was falling into a deep, bottomless pit like a gigantic tube.

It was black and gray, extremely deep, and then I fell into a swamp while being tied up hand and foot.

Here, there were many people also tied up like me, all of them very panicked.

Then a terrifying-looking demon, holding a knife, came forward intending to stab my throat, and I was petrified with fear. Fortunately, a handsome man, dressed very stylishly in a suit, came forward to stop it. Although he did not speak out loud, only communicated mentally, both the demon and I could understand that he was stopping it because I was not a dead person, merely here to visit.

The demon stopped, gave me something to eat, just remember that after eating, my chest hurt terribly, pain as if it wanted to explode, then they gave me some kind of drink, which immediately made me feel normal again. The man in the vest took me away, he reminded me: "This is the Underworld!"

In front of me appeared countless torture rooms, roughly you can imagine similar to medieval torture scenes, or the kind of American soldiers torturing prisoners in movies, then much more brutal executions, just a glimpse was enough to terrify me.

After watching, that man said that my visit to hell was enough, my whole body felt a strong thrust upward, and I opened my eyes abruptly.

However, it wasn't over yet; that person pulled my soul out of my body. At that moment, my whole body felt heavy, falling to the ground, and it was as if someone pressed on me like a heavy stone. Then a large group of people, I don't know where they came from, crowded around me, beating me viciously, scratching, and tearing at me.

Terrified, just like before, I focused on reciting the Great Compassion Mantra. Miraculously, the group of people gradually dispersed and disappeared. Later, I realized that they were the vengeful spirits of my past victims, whom I had harmed in many lifetimes; they had always been lingering around me, waiting for an opportunity to take revenge immediately.

I opened my eyes, ending the third visit to the terrifying hell.

And just two months later, in May 2019, it happened again, so vividly that I felt as though it had just happened yesterday.

That girl came again, I clearly saw my soul step out of the bed, going to a snowy mountain peak, where there was a man dressed like a wealthy young gentleman from Bac Lieu, saying that he had several generations of blood relation with me.

He led me to visit hell and let me know that my uncle was being condemned to hell (I forgot to ask for what crime). Through the entrance gate, I saw about 5 or 6 huge bull-headed demons chasing a group of people, wielding spears wildly.

I panicked, ran very fast, and woke up with a start. Truly horrifying!

And the last time, exactly on two consecutive days, October 29 and 30, 2019. This time, for the first time, I was chased by two people with very strange faces, dressed in white, on a hill. I chanted a spell, and they couldn't catch me. Next, I fell into a deep pit - where a black demon and a white demon were turning a human meat grinder.

It wasn't like a mill, but a standing rectangle, like a soda vending cabinet. The unfortunate soul was thrown in, the demons began to grind, it roared, shaking the heavens and the earth. I dared to look inside and saw nothing but legs, arms, heads, and human blood, mixed up, unimaginably horrifying.

Suddenly, two demons operating the grinder saw me. They came over intending to capture my soul and replace it with another to inhabit my earthly body. Having had experience, I immediately closed my eyes and incessantly chanted Buddha's name. After a while, I felt my body being lifted up, opened my eyes to awaken, terrified, yet I was still not done with curiosity.

The very next night, I was again paralyzed in bed; I saw my soul leave my body and go to bow at the Buddha altar, asking to visit the Underworld once more.

After finishing speaking, my whole body felt light as a feather, and three figures appeared to lift me, flying over houses, trees, rivers, and seas, moving very quickly to reach a tunnel.

Inside, there were dozens of dogs—not ordinary dogs, but hell hounds—each gigantic, the size of about three buffaloes, with teeth sharp to a horrifying degree.

They lunged at me intending to bite and tear me apart, but fortunately, the three figures who had come earlier drove them away. They instructed me to remember well that when I return to the human world, I must tell people to understand: Life is impermanent, life and death are separated by just a hair's breadth, so we must live virtuously, help others, live morally and justly... They also said that I am destined to die in an accident, but if I make an effort in spiritual practice, it can be changed.

One of them asked me: "In the underworld, the most hated sins are murder and sexual immorality. In the human world, have you committed murder or sexual immorality?"

I immediately denied it, but he looked at me and shouted in my face as if he had known the truth for a long time. In the end, I had to confess that I had not killed anyone, but I had committed adultery.

I continued to be led by them to see a few more areas, everywhere was full of horrific scenes with spikes jutting out all over the ground, with bull-headed and horse-faced figures throwing spears rapidly, with souls of the guilty being tortured dreadfully. Finally, they took me back to the mortal world.

Finally, my wish to visit Hell has been fulfilled, not just once, but many times.

Each time was an extremely impressive experience, hard to fade from memory. I became even more confident in the power of Buddhism and gained more faith in living a meaningful life. Being born into this world, all wealth and power are merely fleeting; life and death are separated by only a hair's breadth, not worth taking as goals. One needs to live well, live with kindness and integrity, making virtue and wisdom the goals, only then can one have a bright and happy future.

My story, you may believe it or not, but practicing Buddhism and living a good life is something you absolutely must do, because human life is very fragile; today you exist, tomorrow you may be gone. If you do not use the short years of your life to do meaningful things and instead waste them on vain goals... then there is no certainty that in your next life you will be human again, or that you will have the chance to live a meaningful life again.

(Hoa Tâm – Quang Tử, rewritten from the account of Hoàng Minh Thắng)

tieu_de: A SEXUAL PERSON EASILY ENCOUNTERS FAILURE
tom_tat: Courage is extremely important and necessary in life. Without willpower and spiritual energy, we remain sluggish, weary, timid, and lack confidence in communication, unable to accomplish anything.
noi_dung:
SEXUALLY ADDICTED PEOPLE ARE LIKELY TO FAIL

Courage is extremely important and necessary in life. Without willpower, without mental energy, we become sluggish, lethargic, timid, and lack confidence in communication; we cannot accomplish tasks, nothing succeeds, and we often fall into feelings of discouragement and negativity from which we cannot escape. And this state often appears in people addicted to something, including sex and drugs.

We can reflect on the times we planned to do something like reading a book, completing the remaining paperwork to finish it, participating in a contest, doing a good deed to help others, or planning to exercise for health… and if we had masturbated beforehand, our willpower and desire to complete the next task naturally decrease, or even disappear completely. It turns out that the pleasure of sexual activity erodes mental energy, gnawing away all of our willpower.

There are many people who appear to live very upright and decent lives, not bothering anyone. But their spirit is extremely weak, fragile, easily broken, and easily troubled. Sometimes we see them living very well, yet they haven't achieved any success. Sometimes, deep down, this person has some mistakes, and among many of these mistakes, there is an excessive lust. It is the excessive lust that causes our minds to fall into gloom, continuous distress, reduces work efficiency over time, diminishes intelligence, and makes us extremely easily distracted and easily angered. We should also examine ourselves in the same way. See if we are entangled in this issue or not.

A person who is not easily lustful is someone who is not easily aroused by external stimuli, has good control over their own physiological desires, and usually prefers to live faithfully, so their spirit is also very strong. No matter how poor or difficult things are, we will see that these people have an unusual optimism and strong spiritual energy. Because they enjoy little, after overcoming everything, they can easily succeed.

One of the causes of Depression is overindulgence in pleasure. Each of us has a different pleasure index, just like everyone has different fingerprints and irises. If we recklessly burn that pleasure through sexual indulgence, drugs, or depraved amusements, we will fall into depression. A depressed person is someone who is sad for no reason, suffering for no reason, and keeps wanting to follow that sadness and suffering until they end up committing suicide. The mental energy of such a person is almost exhausted.

To protect the will to start a career, the courage to face difficulties and challenges, a strong optimistic spirit, and moral purity in the heart, as well as to maintain a healthy body and vibrant energy, abstaining from sexual addiction must be prioritized. Consider the harm of sexual indulgence, which is no different from addiction to drugs, alcohol, or gambling, because sexual indulgence is an endogenous drug inherent in all of us.

It is sexual desire that has caused countless people to fail, it is sexual desire that has caused many virtuous people to become corrupt, it is sexual desire that has made people turn away and dislike each other, it is sexual desire that has initiated all worries and sufferings, it is sexual desire that makes people become more selfish and evil, it is sexual desire that gradually darkens this world.

Each person possesses many invisible indices throughout their life, such as longevity index, pleasure index, health index, intelligence index, success index… and these indices continuously fluctuate up and down throughout our life cycle because in one lifetime we do all kinds of right and wrong, good and evil things, so these indices are constantly changing. Among them is the pleasure index, which is the index of the mind experiencing joy, excitement, and exhilaration. If someone enjoys little sensual pleasure, we will see them live very peacefully and rarely worry about trivial matters. As for those who satisfy pleasureHaving too much sex makes this index drop very quickly, causing it to be insufficient to sustain the entire lifespan, leading to the possibility that even before their life ends, that person could become depressed and commit suicide because there is no longer anything joyful or uplifting to live for.

For example, when we are promoted, the joy in our mind is 100 units, when we have a new motorcycle, the joy in us is 60 units. But when we have an orgasm in sex or in addiction to smoking, that joy is 500-1000 units at a time. It is extremely wasteful and useless, so anyone who enjoys a lot falls back into depression, negativity, and pessimism. If our mind is full of insecurity, then surely life cannot be successful, cannot develop well.

Some people would argue that the best way is for us not to be happy or joyful in order to protect our pleasure index, right? The answer is wrong. Because the rule is: Whatever we are, we naturally spread that to everyone around us. If we are negative, stressed, anxious, or troubled, rest assured that everyone around us will also suffer because of us. We only have one way, which is to balance our emotions, live virtuously, righteously, and healthily so that our mind is always joyful, peaceful, and positive, using that mind to bring goodness, love, and benefits to everyone around us. The more we live in suffering, the more we are living wrongly. We canTo struggle, to work hard even more to live, to work, to serve, but we must not allow ourselves to be overly distressed or troubled. When our mind is joyful, it means the pleasure index is being expended, but if we are joyful and then do something beneficial for life, the pleasure index will keep increasing. On the other hand, if we achieve pleasure through indulgence, we become selfish, competitive, and angry, causing suffering for everyone, and the pleasure index will gradually decline until it reaches zero, which is the moment of self-destruction. To have a joyful mind, we must make others joyful; to make others joyful, we must be joyful ourselves. These two things must be done in parallel.

So if the law does not thoroughly deal with someone who commits sexual crimes, or if that person's karmic markers in this life are still abundant but the harm they cause is too great, what will handle it next? The fair Law of Cause and Effect of the universe will handle it next. Those who are immersed in lust will fall into lower levels in this world. Those who, because of desire, spend their whole life vying for and taking the affection of others, will be reborn as hungry ghosts after death. Those who, because of desire, become perverted, debauched, and spread filthy lifestyles, will after death be reborn as herd animals, difficult to return to being human. Those who, because of desire, oppress,if they massacre each other, they will be condemned straight to hell to suffer humiliation.

Surely we cannot completely get rid of lust immediately. But being aware of the harms of pleasurable indulgences allows us to restrain ourselves. If we do not yet have a life partner, we should live healthily; if we do have one, we should live faithfully. In this way, it is already very good. We preserve our health, mind, courage, and morality to engage in long-lasting, practical, and more valuable endeavors.

The reward for a person who knows how to live with restraint is a stable, peaceful mind, an intelligent and creative intellect, and a safe, sustainable life. As for success, glory, and abundant happiness, much more effort is required. A person who knows how to inspire purity and healthiness in the community will be loved by many, will have good connections with others, and will collaborate with them to achieve many meaningful things. A person who lives with restraint is blessed with a body that gradually becomes fragrant, clean, youthful, and increasingly beautiful (according to medicine, because they do not indulge excessively in pleasures, hormones are produced and function more effectively).Stable and long-lasting habits create a fresh and healthy body. A person who lives a life of moderation and then aspires to purity begins to ascend to a very high level in this world in many future lives. Because living a moderate life makes it easier to practice cultivation, to accumulate merit, to be altruistic, and to recognize one's own faults, thereby generating much virtue and reducing many mistakes.

So let's all fight together and overcome lust.

SOURCE: CONTROL OF LUST

tieu_de: . QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS ABOUT CONTROLLING LUST (PART
tom_tat: 41. WHAT ARE THE FIVE DESIRES? - Desire is the enjoyment of pleasures and entertainments of this world. Enjoying desire is a natural thing for humans and all species. Desire, besides meaning sexual desire, also refers to ...
noi_dung:
. QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS ON CONTROLLING LUST (PART

41. WHAT ARE THE FIVE DESIRES?

- Desire is the enjoyment of pleasures and amusements of this world. Enjoying desire is a natural thing for humans and all species. Besides its sexual meaning, desire also includes other pleasures, joys, and attachments. For example:

1. Desire for wealth: Being infatuated with money, material possessions, and talent.

2. Desire for beauty: Being infatuated with beauty and sex.

3. Desire for fame: Being infatuated with status and reputation.

4. Sensuality: Indulgence in eating and drinking.

5. Leisure Lust: Indulgence in resting and relaxing.

- Desires have the characteristics of being addictive and escalating. For this reason, sages throughout history have praised the lifestyle of "little desire, contentment." Living with few desires and minimal indulgence allows the inner self to be virtuous and peaceful. Apart from sexual desire addiction, humans are also addicted to countless other desires, resulting in many sins and consequently, suffering. For instance, some people are addicted to eating, enjoying foods harmful to their health uncontrollably, leading to illness and mental decline. Some people are addicted to rest and entertainment, becoming lazy and passive, causing their careers to falter. Others are addicted to making money and resort to any means to achieve it.experiencing the pleasure of wealth and then getting caught in the cycle of the law. Or some people are addicted to the feeling of being praised, welcomed, and respected by everyone, so they try every way to appear successful and accomplished for others to admire, and eventually, it also collapses. As for sexual addiction, it brings serious consequences, which is easy for us to understand.

- The less someone desires, the less they pursue pleasure, the more virtuous, capable, and successful they become. Speaking according to the law of Karma. Each person has a different index of Desire Merit. That is, the amount of merit one has to enjoy and feel joy in life. Desire Merit is achieved from countless virtuous deeds, responsibilities, and gratefulness accumulated over many lifetimes up to this life. For example, some people may be promiscuous for decades without encountering illness or misfortune because their merit regarding sexual desire is still abundant, whereas others may suffer severe consequences after just one lapse. And desire always has an addictive nature, so enjoying itExcessive desire will deplete one's blessings, and once the blessings are gone, one can no longer enjoy pleasures, no longer have fame, no longer have wealth, no longer have health, no longer have days of leisure and freedom... nothing at all. It's that frightening.

- When we create blessings, generate merit, and produce productivity for life, life returns to us enjoyment, comfort, and peace. But if we enjoy more than we contribute, suffering will come near. Desire always tends to push people to enjoy beyond, to extremely enjoy the blessings they have, leading to many failures and suffering. Knowing this, we should try to live with restraint, staying vigilant with ourselves. We will choose joy in contributing rather than waiting for joy in merely enjoying desires. Life changes when we change.

42. WHY ARE THERE GAY MEN WHO LOOK VERY MASCULINE AND ON THE OTHER HAND, WHY ARE THERE GAY MEN WHO LOOK VERY FEMININE?

- Gay men who are still masculine and dashing are those who in many past lives were still men, but due to heavy lust and enjoying freedom in love, became gay. Gay men who look like women, very feminine, are those who in past lives were girls but were obsessed with sexual desire and craving for enjoyment, possessing the bodies of many men, so they reincarnated as incomplete men (their manner, voice, etc., are still like a woman in a male body). Homosexuality is different from being transgender in that they do not want to change their natural gender. Transgender people are those who have a tendency to want to eatwear, want to undergo surgery to become a gender different from the natural gender currently had.

- If the world continues to follow the trend of sexual freedom, emphasizing desire, then in the future we will increasingly see human gender and sexual orientation becoming more chaotic, messy, and disordered.

- If you want to become another gender in your next life, then in this life you must live with minimal desires, few indulgences, and strive to perform the duties of the gender you wish to become proficiently (if you want to become male, you must be robust, responsible, strong...), (if you want to become female, you must be gentle, proper, graceful...), cultivate deep morality along with the sincere wish to change gender, and in the next life your wish will be fulfilled when your merits are sufficient. If transforming from female to male, you will become a fully male man, if from male to female, you will become an extraordinary woman. An important factor is having few indulgences, minimal desires, and living very morally.responsibility. As for those overly lustful and lacking merit in fulfilling sexual duties, they will be reborn in a mediocre form.

43. WHY ARE THERE PEOPLE WHO LOOK VERY KIND, DO NO HARM TO ANYONE, YET THEIR LIVES ARE EXTREMELY TRAGIC AND SUFFERING?

- The answer is already in the question. Doing nothing that harms anyone but also not doing anything particularly good for the world. Kind but weak-willed, idle, or kind yet diligent, proactive, and responsible toward life. Doing nothing that harms anyone but also not benefiting anyone either. This is something many people fall into. According to the law of Karma, it's fair that those who commit sins suffer, but there is another case. People with very little blessing naturally suffer even without doing anything evil. Suffering comes from two reasons: committing sins or having little blessing.

- People who live while contributing little in terms of productivity, performing few virtuous deeds, and bringing little benefit to the world do not have enough merit to withstand the upheavals of the times and the challenges of life. This is a painful truth that we must accept. That is why we must always strive to live with dedication and responsibility, create much merit, and limit indulgence in pleasures in order to reserve that merit to protect our own existence, safeguard our possessions, defend our honor, preserve our lifespan, and protect those around us… in this life full of countless surprises, impermanence, and fragility.

- Some people may wonder, I am not wealthy, so how can I help anyone? That statement is like those who buy lottery tickets and promise the heavens, “If I win the lottery, I will do charity.” So does that mean if we haven’t won, we don’t need to live well, we don’t need to do charity? If our strength is little, our resources are limited, then we do a little combined with a generous and loving heart, and the greater opportunity for us to contribute will gradually come. The important thing is that we have the heart to want to contribute, the desire to perform good deeds, so don’t be afraid of having nothing to do.

44. RULES TO CHANGE ONE’S FATE?

- Do not blame or accuse others, but courageously take full responsibility for yourself.

- Be tolerant of others' mistakes but strict with yourself.

- Always respect, love, and be kind to everyone without distinction.

- Live diligently, responsibly, and resourcefully in all areas.

- Improve yourself a little every day in all aspects (being 1% better than yesterday is better than exerting 150% effort today and then running out of energy tomorrow).

- Maintain an optimistic, positive, yet realistic mindset.

- Eager to learn and improve contemporary knowledge.

- Always humble, gentle, and admire talented people.

- Not jealous, hateful, bullying, or dictatorial towards anyone.

- Persist in doing good deeds, enjoy performing virtuous acts even when facing your own difficulties.

- Diligent in work, industrious, and exceed productivity expectations.

- Practice and develop many soft skills.

- Live frugally and plan ahead.

- Be close to people who are better than yourself.

- Cultivate comprehensive morality.

- Engage in sports and physical exercise.

- Have a grateful and patient heart.

- Help others improve alongside yourself.

- Have big dreams and ambitions to nurture…

CONTROL DESIRES

tieu_de: The Buffalo Cries When It Knows It Is About to Be Slaughtered
tom_tat: According to news circulated by China’s “People’s News,” there was a surprising incident in Hong Kong, which sounds unbelievable but is true. The “Weekly World News” magazine
noi_dung:
The Buffalo Cries When It Knows It Is About to Be Slaughtered

According to news published by “People’s News” of China, there was a surprising incident in Hong Kong, which sounds hard to believe but is actually true.

The “Weekly World News” reported that a group of workers led a buffalo into a slaughterhouse to prepare it for being killed to make beefsteak and stew ragout.

When they reached the entrance of the kiln, the animal suddenly froze, refusing to move any further. The buffalo knelt on its two front legs and shed tears. How could a buffalo know it was about to be slaughtered before entering the killing pen? This seems to show that it appears to be more sensitive than humans.

The butcher SHIU TAT-NIN recounted that incident with complete emotion: “When I saw an animal that seemed foolish yet knew how to cry, its eyes also showed full fear and sorrow, I suddenly shivered!” He continued: “I hurriedly called everyone to come look, and everyone was as astonished as I was. We all gathered around, some pushing and some pulling the buffalo, but it refused to move; it just sat there and continued to cry!”

The slaughterhouse owner BILLY FONG said: “People always think that these animals are not like humans, that they do not know how to cry, but this buffalo really cried like a child!”

At that moment, there were at least a dozen strong and robust people present, but all of them were moved when they saw the buffalo cry. Even the butchers, who have the daily task of killing cattle in the slaughterhouse, showed even more emotion, as they too shed tears.

When the butchers from other slaughterhouses heard this news, they also rushed over to see. The whole crowd was very surprised by the events happening before their eyes. The three butchers in that group were so moved that they declared that from that moment on, whenever they had to slaughter other creatures, they would not be able to forget the image of this buffalo's tears.

How will the ending be resolved? Seeing both the buffalo and the person shedding tears, we know that the buffalo will no longer be slaughtered. Indeed, some people spent money to buy that buffalo and sent it to a Buddhist temple, where the monks would take better care of it, allowing the buffalo to live peacefully until the end of its life!

Another strange event happened. After the decision was made, the buffalo sensed that its life was safe, it stood up by itself and followed them. SHIU TATNIN exclaimed: “How can a buffalo understand human speech? Whether you believe it or not, this strange event is indeed real.”

Obviously, this buffalo has shaken the lives of the workers in the slaughterhouse!

According to Weekly World News

Translated by Tâm Minh

tieu_de: Some stories about Master Hsuan Hua saving sentient beings
tom_tat: Excerpt from the Book 'The Life and Dharma of Master Hsuan Hua' In his eighteen great vows, the twelfth vow is: I vow to take upon myself all the sufferings of all beings in the Dharma realm to endure in their place
noi_dung:
Some stories about Master Xuan Hua saving sentient beings

Excerpt from the Book Life and Dharma Career of Master Hsuan Hua

Among His eighteen great vows, the twelfth vow is: I vow to take upon myself all the suffering of all sentient beings in the Dharmadhatu to bear it on their behalf. To fulfill this great vow, whenever someone falls seriously ill with an incurable disease and asks Him for help, if He sees that they are sincere, He wholeheartedly seeks every possible way to help them fulfill their wish, because He knows clearly that all illnesses do not originate from the outside of the body, and the body itself is composed of the Four Great Elements: earth, water, wind, and fire in temporary combination. If people do not cling to it and can let go of the body, then there would be no disease.

"Selflessness" means non-attachment, that is, setting aside material pleasures to study and practice the Buddhist teachings to benefit sentient beings, eliminating the attachment to self, and focusing sincerely on reciting the Buddha's name; practicing this method helps people escape the river of delusion and the sea of suffering and attain the permanence, bliss, self, and purity of Nirvana.

The events recorded below are all evidence showing that thanks to His spiritual power, combined with the devotion of the believers, He has saved many people. Therefore, His fame has gradually spread far and wide.

a) Repentance being spiritually responded to

In His village, there was a lady named Truong Ly Thi, over forty years old. For four consecutive years, she suffered from chronic vomiting, and both Eastern and Western medicine were helpless in treating this illness, with all medicines proving ineffective. She heard about His filial virtue and the countless assistance He provided to the villagers, so she respectfully came to the tomb, kneeling and praying for His help. He observed the root cause of the illness and explained to her the principles of being human and that the origin of diseases is a product of the law of cause and effect. He advised her to repent for her past sins and sincerely recite Buddha's name. She followed His advice, practiced diligently, and sincerely repented every day. InOn the twenty-first day, her illness completely healed without the need for medicine.

b) The mother survives.

Outside the village, there was a woman from the Duong Lam family who had been in labor for four consecutive days without being able to give birth. The doctor had no way to save her. Seeing that the mother's life was fragile and the family anxious, they inquired everywhere and finally learned about Him. They hurriedly went to Him hoping for urgent help. He told them to return home and instructed the whole family to offer incense while reciting "Nam Mo Quan The Am Bo Tat" and to vow to eat vegetarian for one hundred days; if they could do this, the mother would give birth safely without any incident.

They returned home and did as He commanded; before long, the baby was born, healthy and safe.

c) Paralysis was cured

In Binh Phong Village, Madam Truong had been paralyzed all over her body for three years. She had been treated by countless doctors and practitioners, yet her condition did not improve. When she heard of His healing of people, her family hired a vehicle to take her to His hut and asked for treatment.

-I know nothing about medicine; but those who have faith can be healed through their sincerity. You just need to sincerely repent for your past sins and practice doing good. If you recite the Buddha's name and stop eating meat, you will definitely receive a response, and your illness will soon recover.

After returning home, every day she worshipped in front of His portrait, ate vegetarian, and recited the Buddha's name. After one hundred days, the paralysis disappeared, and she could move as usual. Her entire family was astonished, knelt to venerate Him as their Teacher, and made a vow to protect the Triple Gem and diligently do good deeds.

d) Vegetarianism can be induced.

About forty miles from the village, there was a man named Đới Quốc Hiền who suffered from a severe stage of lung disease. All the doctors said his condition was hopeless, but he still wanted to live, so he sought out and knelt before the Master, begging for help. Seeing his sincere heart, the Master instructed him to wholeheartedly recite "Namo Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva" and to vow to maintain a vegetarian diet, ending the karma of killing living beings. He joyfully accepted and believed. Then the Master gently sprinkled water on his head while empowering him with Buddha recitation and mantra chanting. At that moment, he felt a refreshing coolness throughout his body and his spirit became invigorated. After that, he took refuge in the Triple Gem and steadfastly practiced the Great Compassion Mantra.He constantly recited the holy name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva without stopping. Soon after, he was healed.

e) Being saved in a dream.

More and more disciples followed Him every day. The entire family of over thirty members of Vuong Phung Nghi in Dong Tinh Tu Village all took refuge in Him. They all practiced vegetarianism and actively supported the propagation of the Buddha's teachings. Vuong Phung Nghi's younger sibling, Vuong Phung Cuu, had a son who suddenly fell seriously ill.

The child's father earnestly pleaded with Him to save his child. Every day, he prayed in front of the Buddha altar. After a week, one night, he dreamed that He came to their house and gave his child a pill. When he woke up, Mr. Vuong found that his child had recovered; from then on, he became even more devoted to the Buddha's teachings and encouraged all his relatives and friends to take refuge in the Triple Gem.

f) Filial devotion is rewarded.

Cao Đức Phú, in Hop Nhi Tan City, Dai Nam District, was naturally filial. When his mother fell seriously ill, he vowed to go to Tam Duyen Pagoda and cut off his arm as an offering to the Buddha, praying that the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas would bless his mother with a speedy recovery. After paying respects at the pagoda, he took out a knife intending to cut off his arm, but someone nearby noticed and stopped him. When asked about the reason, it was revealed that he was a devoted son, willing to sacrifice himself for his mother. Seeing this, layperson Ly Canh Hoa led him to meet Elder Monk Thuong Nhan. The Elder Monk had someone take him to see the Monk. The Monk was deeply moved by his filial piety and immediately agreed to go to his house to help his mother.He told Cao Đức Phúc to ride his bicycle home first while he would walk behind. But when Cao Đức Phúc had just arrived home, he saw that he was already inside the house. Upon entering, he discovered that his mother had been unconscious for seven or eight days; the situation was extremely critical. At that time, the patient's lips and tip of the tongue were darkened, her breathing seemed interrupted. He began writing incantations, then closed his eyes and chanted spells until midnight, only stopping at 3 a.m. The next morning, the patient suddenly sat up in bed and called her child's name. Cao Đức Phúc was both terrified and extremely overjoyed. His mother said:

– Mom has been lost for several days, I don't know how far she has gone. Fortunately, yesterday afternoon, she met a monk who took her home; Now she feels very hungry, so quickly cook porridge for her.

Cao Duc Phuc was very happy to hear this and asked his mother:

– Is the monk you just mentioned this one?

His mother looked at him for a moment and then said:

– That's right! This monk is the one who brought me home.

Through this matter, the entire family of Cao Đức Phúc immediately took refuge in the Three Jewels (Buddhism).

g) Resolving contagious diseases.

In the autumn of the 34th year of the Republic, shortly after the Japanese army surrendered, the Northeast region was very chaotic, and rural people were affected by infectious diseases causing many deaths: both children and the elderly… In Du Phuong Post in the southern part of Hohhot City, there was the Mai family; within three days, all eleven members of the household contracted the disease and died. At that time, only one servant and one son-in-law were in critical condition.

Hearing about such a tragic story, He immediately went around the neighboring towns and villages, sprinkling purified water while reciting the Great Compassion Mantra. The thing is, wherever He sprinkled the water, there were no longer reports of deaths caused by contagious diseases.

h) Eliminating poisonous calamities.

One time, there was a child playing outside, who accidentally had a centipede crawl into their ear and then into their brain. The child suffered severe headaches, a pale complexion, labored breathing, and incessant crying. This centipede was of a poisonous type, and usually, if someone encountered this kind of centipede, there would be no way to cure it. The family brought the child to the Master for help, and the Master sincerely recited a mantra. After a few hours, the child’s complexion and condition returned to normal. From this, it was realized that the power of the mantra is truly beyond imagination; however, the person reciting the mantra must be focused and sincere in intention, must also observe pure precepts, and practice true cultivation, then naturally the Bodhisattvas will protect them, and the Devas and Dragons will support them. Otherwise, even ifThose who are tired of chanting mantras, drawing talismans without strictly observing the precepts, will certainly fall into the path of demons and become demon kings.

i) Saving a person attempting suicide.

In Shangxiao Province, Dongbingzi Station, He'erxin Street, there was a station chief named Li Thang Ti who, over a small matter, quarreled with his wife. His wife, in a moment of anger and lack of clarity, attempted suicide by drinking two cups of luhuo water (Luhuo water is an extremely poisonous chemical; not to mention drinking a cup, even a single sip is enough to kill a person). By the time her family discovered it, she was already in critical condition, and everyone at home was very anxious and worried.

Fortunately, at that time, someone who knew that He was in this station told her family:

– Master An Tu happened to have some business and came to this station; he is currently at the Quach family's house. You all should quickly go and seek his help; perhaps he has a way to cure her.

Ly Thang Ti's son, hearing this, hurriedly ran to the Quach family's house. As soon as he met Him, he knelt down and pleaded with Him to come quickly to save his mother.

– I have no effective method, you should quickly find a doctor to treat her.

The child quietly returned to inform his father. The person who relayed the message was very familiar with Him, so once again, he called the child to come and pray to Him to take action, and he additionally instructed:

– You must sincerely pray, otherwise He will not care about salvation at all!

The child once again ran quickly to Him, knelt down to pray, and cried for forty-five minutes. Knowing that the child was truly sincere, He went with the child to their home. At that time, the mother's hands and feet had grown cold, and the family was preparing her funeral.

As soon as they saw Him arrive, everyone turned toward Him, bowed their heads in respect, and pleaded with Him to save the life. He told them not to be too sorrowful, then used consecrated water infused with the Great Compassion mantra, and with a bamboo stick, opened the patient’s mouth to pour the water in. Before long, the patient began to vomit, and after some time, gradually regained consciousness.

The entire Li family was so grateful to Him that they shed tears, and were also deeply moved by the inconceivable spiritual efficacy of the Dharma. Later, they presented Him with a couplet.

The upper line:

"Compassionately saving all beings, believers attain liberation and Enlightenment."

(Compassion saves everyone, and those with faith are liberated to attain Perfect Enlightenment.)

The verse below: “Transforming fully preserves the spirit, performing this ritual ensures blessings to meet the Unborn.”

(Disasters are avoided, the spirit is restored to attain enlightenment in the Unborn.)

Accompanied by a plaque inscribed: “Tathagata of Freedom.”
