tom_tat: The Buddha Summit Supreme Victory, in Sanskrit called uṣṇīṣa-vijaya dhāraṇī, is also known as 'Eliminating Obstructions Buddha Summit'. The Buddha Summit Supreme Victory is a supreme mantra of the Mahayana, and for the tradition of Vajrayana practitioners, it is very
noi_dung:
BUDDHA'S CROWN SUPREME VICTORY DHĀRAṆĪ (uṣṇīṣa-vijaya dhāraṇī)

The Buddha Peak Supreme Victory, in Sanskrit, is called uṣṇīṣa-vijaya dhāraṇī, and is also known as 'Eliminating Obstacles at the Buddha Peak'. Buddha Peak Supreme Victory is a supreme vehicle mantra. For the tradition of Vajrayana practitioners, the miraculous power of this mantra is highly valued. It is called 'Supreme Dharma Victory' and is also considered the 'Pure Supreme Victory Mantra of All Beasts'. According to the Sutra of Buddha Peak Supreme Victory Dharani, it is recorded that: 'Tathagata Contemplating the Pure Beasts Buddha Peak Supreme Victory Dharani' consists of eighty-eight verses, hundreds of thousands of Buddhas have expounded it, jointly guarded and praised, and performing the seal together.

certificate.

Because this Dharani eradicates all five grave sins and the ten evil acts of sentient beings, it saves all suffering in the realms of Yama, non-human beings, hungry ghosts, and hell, and it can liberate all sentient beings who have heavy karma, little merit, poverty, lowliness, sickness, disability, short life, ugliness, muteness, blindness, and deafness. This Dharani also saves all types of Asuras, Yakshas, Rakshasas, Punyadanas, Katrapunyadanas, and other spirits, and even liberates aquatic creatures, birds, fleeing animals, snakes, scorpions, flies, mosquitoes, and insects, allowing them to attain freedom.

According to historical records written during the reign of Emperor Gaozong of the Tang Dynasty, in the Nghi Phượng era, a high monk from the country of Thiên Trúc, named Buddhapàli, traveled to pay homage to sacred sites in China. During his pilgrimage at Mount Wutai, he met an elderly man who advised him to return to Thiên Trúc (India) to request the Sutra of the Supreme Victorious Dharani from the Buddha and transmit it to the Chinese people for practice, as the karmic seeds here were profound and thick. In the Vĩnh Thuận era, he went to the capital Chang'an; after the emperor heard of the miraculous events at Mount Wutai, he bestowed upon him the title of Sun-Illuminating Tripitaka Master and authorized the translation and dissemination of this sutra.

until today.

This mantra is very miraculous, with inconceivable power, liberating sentient beings from suffering in the six realms of birth and death. The Buddha said: The Buddha's Supreme Vajra Dharani I possess has sufficient spiritual power, vast merit like the shining sun, like a pure mani jewel without stain, illuminating everywhere with light. Just as the seven kinds of supreme treasures in the world are all cherished and liked by kings, officials, and people, one never tires of looking at them. This Dharani is likewise; if one observes, recites, copies, or offers it, that person will receive immeasurable merits, and all the celestial beings and the eight classes of followers will respect it. If there are kings, lords, officials, and people… etc., copiedCopy this dharani and place it in the seven-treasure tower, at the place of the lion, where the tower is at the crossroads, or hang it on a high banner, using things like incense, flowers, offerings, clothing, etc., to make offerings to this dharani. The person who makes offerings will attain immeasurable and boundless merit, increase immeasurable wisdom. That person is truly a child of the Buddha, a great Bodhisattva, because they have saved countless sentient beings who pass by or travel to places where this mantra is venerated. If there are sentient beings who commit the four gravest sins, the five heinous crimes, the ten evil deeds, violate major precepts, and all serious offenses, after death they will fall into the three lower realms to suffer. If they have affinity with the Three Jewels and pass by the tower or the banner where this dharani is kept, and dust or a gust of wind touches their body,Or if one is covered by the shadow of a stupa or banner, all grave sins are completely eliminated, one is reborn in the heavenly realm to enjoy supreme happiness, and afterward will be reborn in the Pure Lands of the ten directions. Therefore, in Buddhist countries such as India, China, Japan, Korea, and Vietnam, monasteries and monks, nuns, and lay Buddhists have erected many stupas, and inscribed this mantra on stupas or stone pillars, with the aim of bringing benefits to all sentient beings in the dharma realm.

If there are monks, nuns, good men, or good women who uphold and recite this, the merits can eliminate the five heinous crimes and ten evil deeds for countless kalpas, and they will attain the fruit of Anuttara-samyak-sambodhi. If anyone upholds this dharani, all disasters and calamities will be eliminated, in this life they will gain wisdom endowed with a long life, and later they will roam freely in the heavenly realms and the Buddha realms. That person will be blessed by Bodhisattvas such as Manjushri, Samantabhadra, Avalokiteshvara, and Mahasthamaprapta, who will place their hands on their head to give prophecy, and they will often be in the assembly, listening, understanding, and upholding the true Dharma. That person's three karmas (body, speech, and mind) will always be pure, their mind will be peaceful and joyful, their bodily suffering and sensations will be eliminated, they will feel lightness, their lifespan will increase, and they will not be suddenly..."die (one cannot buy a child).

If someone upholds, recites, transcribes, or makes offerings of this dharani, they will receive immeasurable merit, enjoy supreme joy, be respected by deities, dragons, and the eight classes of beings, be protected by benevolent spirits, loved by bodhisattvas, and be supported by Buddhas. Those who uphold this mantra, even if they go to hell, become hungry ghosts, or are sinners, will be liberated.

If someone is seriously ill and suffering greatly, hearing this mantra will quickly heal their illness and eradicate their sins. Indeed, all living beings who hear this mantra will be free from sickness and suffering, will escape the womb, and be reborn from a lotus flower, according to their wishes, and will know the cause of their previous life. If anyone recites this mantra once into the ear of any animal or beast, in their next life they will no longer take the body of an animal or beast, even if they have heavy karma leading them to fall into various types of hells, they will thereby also be liberated.

If someone has not yet recited this mantra, but hears the sound of this Dharani, they immediately become a seed of Buddha. Once this mantra enters the ear, it accumulates into the fruition of supreme enlightenment, and even heavy karma cannot obstruct it. Even if that person falls into hell, becomes a hungry ghost, or is reborn in a low realm, they do not lose the seed of bodhi, and they can rely on the power of that mantra to begin practicing until they achieve Buddhahood. If any sentient being hears this Dharani even once, in the next life they will be free from diseases and suffering; their six eyes gradually purify, they attain clairvoyance, their accumulated karma is eliminated, and they will realize the supreme perfect enlightenment.

If anyone recites this mantra every day and receives offerings from all beings in the world, upon leaving their physical body, they will be reborn in the Pure Land. If someone upholds this mantra, from this life onward, they will forever leave the evil realms, be born into a noble family in the human world, or ascend to the heavens, eventually being reborn in the pure lands of the Buddhas in the ten directions, befriending Bodhisattvas, and will attain the Supreme Perfect Enlightenment. If someone has just died or has been dead for a long time, and someone recites this dharani, wholeheartedly dedicating the merit to pray for rebirth in the pure lands of the Buddhas in the ten directions, even if the deceased's consciousness has fallen into hell, into hungry ghost realms, or into animal existence, etc., they can also be liberated from the evil realms.

Reincarnation, being born into the heavenly realm. In this book, we only introduce the complete version, which is mostly recited and circulated in countries around the world. tieu_de: BRIEF OVERVIEW OF VENERABLE TUYEN HOA
tom_tat: Venerable Master Hsuan Hua's surname was Bach, given name An Tu, and courtesy name Du Luận. He was born in Songcheng County, Tongjiang Province in the Northeast of China, that is, Manchuria. His father's name was Phu Hai, who specialized in farming.
noi_dung:
BRIEF OVERVIEW OF VENERABLE TUYEN HOA

Venerable Master Hsuan Hua, surname Bạch, real name An Từ, courtesy name Độ Luân. He was born in Songcheng County, Tungkiang Province in Northeast China, which is Manchuria.

His father was named Phú Hải, who made a living as a farmer. His mother’s surname was Hồ, and she gave birth to a total of eight children, five boys and three girls; and he was the youngest.

Lady Hồ Thái practiced a strict vegetarian diet, recited Buddha's name, and never interrupted her practice. One night, she dreamed of Amitabha Buddha appearing in person, emitting a great light that illuminated the entire world, shaking heaven and earth. Startled awake, she smelled a wondrous fragrance throughout the room, and then gave birth to Him.

From the moment of His birth, He cried continuously for three days and nights without stopping. This was because of the sorrow for the sufferings of the world of Saha.

He lived in a very small countryside village, where houses were sparse. Therefore, by the time he was eleven years old, he had never seen a dead person. One day, he was playing in the fields with friends from the village. Suddenly, he saw a baby, mouth closed, eyes shut, lying wrapped in a pile of straw at the roadside. He called but the baby did not respond, touched it but there was no breath. He was extremely puzzled, so he asked his friends. Someone knowledgeable said, "The baby is dead!" Yet he was very surprised and did not understand what death meant. At home, he immediately asked his mother, and she taught him: "Every human being must die. Some die of old age, some die because of illness, and some die because ofAccidents. Regardless of wealth or poverty, whether scholar, farmer, worker, merchant, or official, everyone eventually must die.

He then asked, "If that is true, is there any way to escape death?" At that time, a guest in the house who had previously practiced the Way replied, "The only way is to cultivate the Way, to realize the mind, to thoroughly see one's original nature; only then can one put an end to birth and death, transcend the cycle of reincarnation, attain Perfect Enlightenment, and realize Non-Birth."

Although he was still young at that time, he was deeply awakened by the words of the guest. As a result, he firmly decided to dedicate himself to leaving home and cultivating the Way.

When he discussed ordination with his mother, she said: "Ordaining is a very good thing, but it is not an easy matter. One needs good roots of virtue, great vows, and must develop the great Bodhi mind in order to accomplish the Supreme Way. Now that you have this intention, I fully agree, and it truly aligns with the dream of the past. I am old now, and my days are not many; your siblings have all become independent. You should stay to care for your parents; after I have passed away, you can ordain and practice, and by then it will not be too late."

He obeyed his parents, and then every day often followed his mother to worship Buddha. After worshiping Buddha, he would bow to his parents.

Day by day, winter passed and spring came, he respectfully cared for his parents as if they were Buddha. Before long, his reputation for filial piety spread far and wide, and then everyone called him Bach Hieu Tu (the extremely filial son of the Bach family).

When He was 19 years old, His mother passed away; at that time, He bid farewell to his relatives, went to the temple to pay respects to Venerable Thường Trí as his Master, took refuge, officially became a monk, and received precepts. Afterwards, He returned to his mother's gravesite to observe filial piety for three years. During that time, He lived in a small straw hut, day by day meditating, reading the Mahayana scriptures, and reciting the name of Amitabha Buddha. Many times, He would sit in meditation and enter Samadhi, continuing for many weeks without leaving the meditation seat.

One night, the villagers from nearby were horrified to see His thatched hut blazing with red fire. The pink flames shot straight up into the sky, and the hut shone brightly as if it were daytime. Many people ran to the grave, shouting: "The Filial Devotee’s house is on fire!" Hundreds of villagers hurriedly grabbed buckets and ladled water to put out the fire. However, when they arrived, they only saw the thatched hut calm, the fire not burning, and He remained serene, quietly sitting in meditation!

Once, while He was meditating, a visitor suddenly came to pay respects. To His surprise, the visitor was none other than the Sixth Patriarch Huệ Năng! The Patriarch told Him that in the future He would go to America to save sentient beings, that in the West He would meet many destined people who could propagate the Dharma, and that He would save countless sentient beings. Only after the Patriarch had bid farewell and left did He awaken suddenly, remembering that Huệ Năng had originally lived during the Tang dynasty, 1,200 years ago. After the Second World War, He wandered everywhere. Finally, after traveling more than three thousand miles, He arrived at Nam Hoa Temple to pay respects to the great wise teacher of the time, Elder Hư Vân.At that time, the Old Zen Master was 109 years old; the moment he saw him, the Old Zen Master immediately recognized his enlightenment. At that moment, the Old Zen Master said, "Thus, thus!"; and he also replied, "Thus, thus!"

At that time, Elder Master Hư Vân confirmed the attainment of His disciple, and He officially became the ninth Patriarch of the Quy Ngưỡng Dharma lineage.

Afterwards, the Elder Master instructed Him to stay at the temple and assume the position of Director of the Vinaya Institute at Nam Hoa Temple.

In 1950, He bade farewell to the temple and set off for Hong Kong. There, He lived in a secluded mountain cave, completely detached from worldly affairs and secular desires. Soon, countless monks from Mainland China came to Hong Kong as refugees, and they needed His assistance. Eventually, in accordance with karma, He left the mountain cave, established a lecture hall and two temples, and also helped in building many other dharma centers.

Throughout twelve years in Hong Kong, He was a bright example, ascetic, diligent in practicing the Way, selfless for the Dharma. He influenced countless virtuous men and faithful women, inspiring them to generate the Bodhi mind, take refuge in the Three Jewels, and support the Dharma.

In 1962, He came to San Francisco, USA. There, in a small warehouse, He diligently practiced in silence, waiting for the right time to propagate the Dharma fully. At that time, He called Himself "Monk in the Tomb" or "Living Dead Person". Buddhists who understood His genuine practice were deeply moved and respectfully supported and offered alms to Him.

In 1968, He knew the opportunity had come; He said: "A flower will bloom with five petals." That summer, He presided over a Dharma Assembly to teach the Shurangama Sutra for 96 days. When the Dharma Assembly ended, indeed, five Americans were the first to request ordination with Him.

From that time on, He continued to preside over many other Dharma Assemblies, explaining the Heart Sutra, the Kṣitigarbha Sutra, the Lotus Sutra, the Dharma Jewel Altar Sutra, etc. In 1971, He taught the supreme sutra of Mahayana, which is the Avataṃsaka Sutra.

Alongside preaching the Sutras and delivering Dharma talks, He also performed countless other meritorious deeds for guiding sentient beings. In 1976, He established the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, a foundational base for propagating Buddhism in the United States. At the City, He set up a monastic system, training monks, nuns, and lay practitioners, creating excellent conditions for genuine cultivation practice.

tieu_de: THE SACRED RESPONSE OF THE MYSTIC INCANTATION LĂNG NGHIÊM
tom_tat: (Sharing from Buddhist layperson Tâm Hạnh) Speaking of the Ling Yan Bodhisattva. I had a hook pillar more than 10 years ago, now I am 34 years old. I want to share with you all. With dear fellow practitioners. The miraculous nature of the Dharma.
noi_dung:
THE SACRED MIRACULOUS MANTRA OF LANG NGHIEM

(Sharing from Buddhist Tâm Hạnh)

Speaking of the Lăng Nghiêm mantra. I had a hanging column more than 10 years ago, and now I am 34 years old. I want to share with you, along with fellow practitioners, the miraculous effects of the Buddhist teachings on my family. It's beyond words. The Lăng Nghiêm mantra has indeed changed the profession and karma of my family. Exactly 12 years ago, I had been practicing a vegetarian lifestyle for 2 years, but I was still selling meat dishes. That was a dish I came up with myself at the time and named it. I would sell it to students, a rice paper mixed dish that was very expensive, sometimes earning me several million in a day. But do you know? Practicing vegetarianism while selling meat—I truly felt no joy at all. But due to family circumstances, I had to support my entire household alone.person. Even though I earn money from selling. But I don't understand why every day, what I stir on that day, I still end up missing here and lacking there. Maybe it's because I lack virtue. Every night I also pray to the higher powers for me to change my profession. Not to be involved with the lives of sentient beings. I don't know if it's fate, but I came to know about Master Lăng Nghiêm online. I studied and tried learning to see how it goes. I sincerely hope I can learn thoroughly, to change my profession. Do you guys know?

I sell things by the beach. Because students are on summer vacation, I sell goods from my motorbike starting from home. It takes 20 minutes to get to the beach. I occasionally recite a small, serious little book that fits in the palm of my hand. I just recite in my head while on the bike. When I get there, I put it in my shirt pocket. For 3 days I went on the road like that. Only 20 minutes. I memorized it without even realizing it. In Vietnamese. I tried learning Sanskrit. Back then I put all my heart into learning it. But just experimenting. And I learned Sanskrit faster than Vietnamese. After memorizing a section, every night at 2 a.m. I would practice diligently. Truly marvelous. In half a month, I had transformed my fate. From selling salty food, I switched to selling vegetarian food. And during that timeI didn't even have 100 thousand in my hand. There was a Buddhist sister in the US who saw my wish to sell vegetarian food. Haha, but to be honest, I didn't know how to cook. I just liked selling to create connections. At that time, I don't know how Buddha guided it, but that sister lent me 40 million. Honestly, I never even asked to borrow money. I don't know if she just sensed it or what. To me, that was a huge gift. I was so happy that I cried. I rented a small place. The main purpose of opening the shop was to create connections. After just 2 months, I also sent the money back to her. I am truly grateful for all her kindness. The blessings of the guardians guided me. Even in my dreams, I couldn't have imagined it. The Dharma is miraculous. With diligent practice, even someone who didn't know how to cook.running. I just keep praying for the Buddhas to bless me. Let me cook really delicious food. Prepare many dishes so that everyone can fully receive the nectar of the Buddhas. Every morning I chant sutras. Just keep making vows like that. I offer meals to the deities every day. I pray that whoever receives this food, vegetarians, will transform their heart to stay vegetarian permanently. Those who are seriously ill will gradually recover. After offering, I bring it downstairs to share the meal with guests. Such a small transformation, but my place has inspired many people to eat vegetarian. Our house is rented. Once we finish here, we move to another place. The whole family didn’t understand the Dharma, but now we are completely liberated. My family, from the young to the old, all stay vegetarian.Running for more than 10 years now. I was the pioneer to go first. My mother back then was a savory chef in bars. But thanks to Buddha, my mother changed. My father was drunk all the time. But now he has quit everything. My sibling was rebellious, doing drugs, borrowing money at high interest. In general, the family was like hell, guys. Saying out what we went through. It was truly terrifying. Probably on the extreme end of society. The house also belonged to others. There was no place for proper worship. But now my family has a spacious house. I truly share with you, my dear friends of the faith. And my tears keep flowing. Truly, I do not know how to repay Buddha. So I worship Buddha and believe in Him. I hope each of us believe and make effort.Practice will lead to achievement. Namo Amitabha Buddha. This is a peaceful place where the family can return to.

tieu_de: Homage to Amitabha Buddha
tom_tat: ABSTINENCE FROM SEXUAL ACTIVITY Abstinence from sexual activity is the practice of refraining from sexual relations, giving up lustful thoughts, and not committing sexual misconduct for a certain period of time. Before completely ending the habit of sexual indulgence, one must
noi_dung:
Namo Amitabha Buddha

ABSTAIN FROM SEXUAL ACTIVITY

Abstaining from sexual activity is the practice of refraining from physical relations, abandoning lustful thoughts, and not committing sexual sins for a certain period of time. Before completely ending the act of masturbation, the practitioner must go through many stages of sexual abstinence to gradually purify both body and mind. Abstaining from sexual activity is also a duty, a sacred responsibility that a virtuous person, a just person, needs to carry out. Abstaining from sexual activity is also a measure of a person’s willpower and moral strength.

When should we abstain from sexual activity:

- A person preparing for an important business social engagement, getting ready to meet a strategic partner, should practice sexual abstinence beforehand. This will help the business proceed more smoothly, sharpen the intellect to handle and judge work accurately, and increase patience to achieve success. Conversely, if they masturbate a few days before, the likelihood of failure increases.

- People preparing to participate in competitions or contests to earn degrees, high scores, etc., should avoid sexual activity as much as possible. Sexual activity causes the brain to lose a key factor for success, which is Concentration. Abstaining from sexual activity at this time helps the body, mind, and intellect to focus intensely on training and studying, thereby achieving good results.

- A person who is undergoing the test of chastity before ordaining as a monk or nun to live a pure, undefiled life. This is a prerequisite. If one cannot overcome sexual activity, it is very difficult to maintain a noble and diligent monastic life. Sexual activity erodes virtue, willpower, and motivation faster than anything else in this world. A person who abstains from sexual desires will have enough strength to prevent many other mistakes.

- People who are preparing to open a business, prepare for a long business trip, prepare to be appointed, or prepare to do important things in life should abstain from sexual activities, as this will increase the invisible virtue in their mind, making everyone around them admire them, gaining the support and recognition of deities, and giving the person calmness and intelligence to take on new responsibilities in life. Engaging in sexual activities at this time can easily lead to bad luck and misfortune.

- People preparing to start a family and intending to have children. Addiction to sexual desires will deplete vitality, weaken willpower, reduce wealth, and diminish virtue, leading to frequent conflicts, unnecessary disharmony, and susceptibility to accidents, misfortunes, or illnesses. Therefore, before starting a family, living a pure life and abstaining from sexual activity is very important. Those who abstain from sexual activity will also be loyal in marriage, not changing their hearts or character. Those who abstain from sexual activity will have sufficient vitality and health to give birth to healthy and intelligent children.

- We must also abstain from sexual activity on sacred days such as the full moon, the important days of the Saints, New Year's Eve, and the three days of the Lunar New Year. Because on these days, the righteous energy arises more in heaven and earth, and the Deities pay more attention to observing the world. Therefore, those who follow the precepts will receive more joy and small blessings in life.

- We also need to abstain from sexual activity during urgent situations, during dangerous phases of life, or at times when sincerely seeking the help of the Divine, hoping for support from everyone in life. Life is certainly not smooth or convenient. There will be challenges, adversities, and suffering. And at these times, in order to have enough inner strength to overcome, enough morality to receive help, and enough reason to resolve issues, it is necessary to abstain from sexual activity.

We can practice abstaining from sexual activity according to a schedule: Abstain for 3 days, Abstain for 5 days, Abstain for 7 days, Abstain for 2 weeks, Abstain for 1 month, Abstain for 3 months, ... Each time we abstain from sexual activity and cleanse our body and mind, we become like a new person full of determination, energy, and strength, as well as enhancing our morality and character.

Abstaining from sexual activity involves three aspects:

- Not thinking about sexual matters.

- Not speaking sexual words.

- Not acting on sexual desire.

For those without religion, you should make a personal vow to yourself to abstain from sexual activity in order to live a healthier and happier life. As for those with religion, you should kneel and swear before the God you worship that you will abstain from sexual activity for a certain period of time, asking God to give you the strength to adhere to moral discipline and overcome yourself, and pray that all people live purified and clean lives.

Of course, supporting a healthy life requires many other factors such as exercising, studying and acquiring knowledge, living virtuously, lovingly, and responsibly, sleeping and eating scientifically, and improving morals in various aspects…

There is never a single arrow that can destroy lust. Lust must be eliminated and must be approached from many aspects to isolate it, control it, and neutralize it.

Wishing all of you interesting experiences on the journey of controlling lust. May everyone achieve extraordinary virtue and talent.

Source: fb CONTROL LUST

tieu_de: THE LAW OF REPENTANCE TO DESTROY KARMIC CONDITIONS - THE TRUE WORD OF BODHISATTVA KṢITI GARBHA
tom_tat: (Respectfully recounted according to the Teacher's teachings) 🙏 In the esoteric texts, there is a repentance practice of Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha, which relies on the power of the Mantra for Eradicating Karmic Obstacles to help practitioners quickly eliminate
noi_dung:
THE REPENTANCE CEREMONY TO DESTROY KARMIC DESTINIES, THE TRUE WORD OF KŌJIZŌ BOSATSU

(Respectfully recounted according to the teachings of Master)

🙏 In the Esoteric Treasury, there is a repentance practice of Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha, which relies on the power of the mantra for eliminating karmic obstacles to help practitioners quickly remove transgressions: OM PRA MANI DHANI SVAHA. The repentance practice of the mantra for eliminating karma sets the 14th and 28th of the lunar month as days dedicated to focused cultivation and repentance. On the 14th and 28th of the lunar month, if one sincerely practices this repentance method, countless karmic obstacles can be eliminated, and progress on the path of Dharma will be quick. Since karmic obstacles are removed, worldly aspirations as well as transcendental practice in this life will be easily fulfilled, and one will readily receive the blessings of Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha.Bodhisattva. You all follow the repentance schedule as follows:

1. Bathe thoroughly, wear solemn and neat clothing. On that day, eat vegetarian food and keep the five precepts (do not kill, do not steal, do not commit sexual misconduct including with your spouse until refraining from lustful thoughts, do not lie, do not drink alcohol or consume stimulants).

2. Depending on your capability, prepare incense, lamps, flowers, fruits... to offer to Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva, or you may also make a vow to draw His image to offer.

3. Kneel with hands clasped in front of the statue of Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva to request Him to preside over and witness the repentance session on that day. If there is no statue or altar, then clasp your hands and mentally remember the Bodhisattva residing in the southern direction.

4. Healthy, young, and less sick individuals should kneel with hands clasped while chanting the Mantra for Eliminating Karma. If using a mala, there is no need to clasp hands, but the mind must remain reverent.

5. Sincerely recite the mantra 1080 times. If you have completed the recitation but still want to recite more for faster effectiveness, it is even better: OM PRA MANI DHANI SVAHA (Om pra ma ni da ni soa ha).

6. After finishing the recitation, you face the Bodhisattva to reveal your repentance, wholeheartedly feel remorse, and then disclose all the sins of this life such as eating meat, drinking alcohol, using stimulants, sexual misconduct, abortion, theft, lying, speaking cruel words, scolding, slandering or making attacking remarks that cause discord, being greedy and stingy, anger like fire, being deluded and attached, etc., as well as wrong habits accumulated over many lifetimes that are hard to eliminate: enjoying masturbation, nocturnal emission, watching obscene movies, looking at women, often having affairs, being easily angered, laziness, dozing off during practice, etc., all of which should be courageously and honestly disclosed to the Bodhisattva, with a vow to try your bestcompletely eliminate and not commit again, pray to the Bodhisattva to witness and bless one's repentance and vows.

7. After repentance, kneel to pay respect and feel gratitude for the virtues of the Bodhisattva and recite His name.

8. Notes:

- If anyone wants to quickly eliminate karmic obstacles, it is very good to practice this repentance method daily; it is very valuable! This repentance method is very strong in dispelling karmic obstacles.

- Those who generate a great Bodhi mind and have compassion can use this repentance practice to repent on behalf of all sentient beings, praying that they quickly eliminate their karma, increase wholesome roots, soon have the opportunity to study the true Dharma, know refuge in the Three Jewels and Kṣitigarbha, and progressively cultivate until the day they achieve perfect Buddhahood. Sentient beings in metaphysical realms suffer greatly, with no one to help them, and they do not know how to repent in order to escape karma. Moreover, many sentient beings nowadays engage in wrongful occupations: cooking, killing living beings, stealing, deceiving, lying, dishonest trading, adulterySexual misconduct, prostitution... up to being unfilial to parents, disrespectful to teachers, not believing in the law of cause and effect of good and evil, slandering the Triple Gem, etc., these karmic offenses will lead to the retribution of descending endlessly into the hells. If you can generate the mind to repent for these sins on behalf of sentient beings for their sake, they will be infinitely grateful to you. This is also a very good way to widely establish karmic connections with all beings and to cultivate the Bodhi mind for yourself.

🌷🌷🌷 Sincerely wishing you always peace and progress in the true Dharma of the Tathagata.

tieu_de: Opening Up When Studying and Chanting the Lăng
tom_tat: NGHIÊM Dear friends who practice together, love Thích, and recite CHÚ lăng nghiêm in the group
noi_dung:
SHARING FEELINGS WHILE LEARNING AND CHANTING THE STUPA

SOLEMN

Dear friends practicing together who love and recite the solemn MANTRA in the group

I am Nguyen Thuan Hanh, and I have a special affinity that made me vow to memorize the MANTRA in 2 months, and I DID memorize it after 5 weeks

At first, honestly, looking at the long MANTRA, I also felt I didn't know if I could memorize it

On the first day, I reported to the Master and asked for help to memorize the MANTRA quickly

Then I made an offering at my home Tam Bao.

I VOW TO BELONG TO CHU LANG NGHIEM TO UPHOLD THE DHARMA AND HELP LIVING BEINGS WHO ARE UNDERGOING TREATMENT IN EPIDEMIC AREAS IN VIETNAM AND AROUND THE WORLD.

Every day I pray like this.

When I started learning, I received guidance from Lam Son Trang, who taught very carefully for beginners learning CHU Ln.

For example, when starting to recite the first phrase that needs to be memorized, it is MA MA AN THO NA MA MA TOA (the last phrase of each chapter).

The meaning is to ask the elders to enlighten and guide us in our practice.

Then, when reciting the Nam Mô mantra, start with a respectful mind BECAUSE the meaning is taking refuge, showing respect, and turning back.

AND the word Hồng should be recited lightly BECAUSE its meaning is like a call to battle... so turn back with a repentant mind.

The word DU LAM should be recited lightly...

Dear friends, every day I recite the Lăng Nghiêm mantra 10 to 15 times.

The way to learn is to read and write each section, record that section, then recite it until memorized, close your eyes and go through the memorized part, open your eyes, and continue learning the next section.

Just like that, accompanying it with anything, listen to the recording and silently read along to memorize it quickly

Especially repeat it in your mind before sleeping and after waking up to remember it longer

Additionally, be very grateful to your Master; many people follow the instructions wanting to quickly memorize, add the infinite commentary to the Kṣitigarbha teachings

Follow the instructions to apply all the knowledge obtained to study, as the Kṣitigarbha Sutra teaches: let the water jar stand overnight on the Kṣitigarbha altar, and in the morning turn it to face south to drink

Follow the instructions like this until you memorize it

Dear beloved family, most Joyful and Miraculous, what I want to share is that I have paid homage to the BUDDHA and the Ancestors who assisted in influencing the mind, so that my husband and children also generated the aspiration to recite the Lăng Nghiêm CHANT.

That morning, I told my husband, and my husband said it's too long, he probably wouldn't recite it.

By noon, he asked me what I thought about reciting the Lăng Nghiêm?

Needless to say, I was so happy.

Silently, I am grateful to the BUDDHA, the Ancestors, and my Master for protecting my family.

AND MY HUSBAND RECITED 1 VARIATION, AFTER 1 WEEK INCREASED TO 3 SERIOUS VARIATIONS EVERY DAY

I HAVE only been vegetarian for 3 years, my husband has been vegetarian for 2 years

I am grateful to the group and everyone WHO motivated and diligently practiced every day, serving as motivation for me to quickly memorize

Furthermore, the Master taught that when reciting, imagine a white blanket protecting the epidemic-affected areas

I practice according to the Master's teachings when I haven't memorized yet; the white blanket is a small square just enough to cover the top of my head

After mastering the practice of holding the white umbrella that is huge and wide, as if covering an entire stadium, FROM the top looking down, there are clearly visible ropes extending toward the outer rim, and especially underneath, compartments like a field hospital, with many people walking around...

PEOPLE who do not know how to practice holding the white umbrella will run away ...hu

When practicing quickly, I glimpsed Venerable Master PHỔ QUANG or Venerable Master Tuyên Hóa...

THE POWER OF MASTER LANG NGHIEM IS VERY WONDERFUL. IT AFFECTS KARMIC BODIES. HD felt an itch on the right shoulder, after a period of time, pain occurred. The right hand felt as if stabbed through the palm with a knife... (HD HAD once killed when cooking in the kitchen). HD understood that their karma had been created, so they sincerely repented and gradually gave insight, and the pain slowly disappeared...

May this sharing help everyone diligently practice Lang Nghiem every day, so that we can change our way of thinking, cherish life, choose vegetarianism, avoid killing, release life, give alms, make offerings according to our conditions and vows, so that the epidemic will pass quickly.

Namo Supreme Buddha Peak Mahā Tāṭa Datta Bhadra Dharani

Namo Eighty-four thousand countless Adota Kṣara Diamond Treasury Bodhisattva Protector of Lăng Nghiêm Dharani

Namo Dharma Protecting Venerable Bodhisattvas

Namo Lăng Nghiêm Assembly Supreme Buddha Bodhisattvas

Grateful to Tâm Phong Thích Huyen Vo, Trần Kiều, Thư Anh Hoang An Nhiên PT

Nguyễn Ngọc Cương

Photo group of Lăng Nghiêm practice and secret mantra in Hanoi Thái Nguyên

(Buddhist practitioner Hằng Đinh)

tieu_de: THE BENEFITS OF SINCERELY CHANTING THE SACRED NAME 'NAMO GUANSHI YIN BODHISATTVA'
tom_tat: You often recite Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva: You will no longer have a greedy nature. Because the Bodhisattva will help you cultivate compassion, practice the virtue of giving, making you always want to give to others without any selfish intention.
noi_dung:
THE BENEFITS OF SINCERELY CHANTING THE SACRED NAME "NAMO GUAN SHI YIN BODHISATTVA"

You often recite Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva: You will no longer have a greedy nature. Because the Bodhisattva will help you nurture compassion, practice generosity, making you always want to give to others rather than have the intention to take others' wealth.

If you often recite Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva: You will no longer be angry. Because the Bodhisattva will help you have great compassion and wisdom. With compassion, you will empathize and understand people's circumstances without anger. With wisdom, you will understand that the world is impermanent, all things arise from conditions, so whether they come or go, you will not be angry.

If you often recite Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva: You will no longer be ignorant. Because the Bodhisattva will help you open pure wisdom. With wisdom, you will understand the principle of dependent origination, that there is coming together and separation, and you will not cling to or be attached to any person or thing.

You often recite the name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva: You will no longer fear falling into the three evil paths, because you have eliminated the three poisons of greed, anger, and ignorance.

You often recite the name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva: You will no longer be afflicted by incurable diseases, or even if you suffer from incurable diseases and countless other illnesses, you will be cured. Because in the Five Hundred Names, his virtuous name is praised: "Not to die from malignant disease."

If you often chant the name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva: You will no longer have any suffering. Because in the Sutra of Universal Gate, Buddha Shakyamuni taught, “If there are countless hundreds of thousands of myriads of beings suffering various pains, and they hear the name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, and wholeheartedly recite the name, Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva will immediately follow the sound of their plea and save them.”

If you often chant the name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva: Whether you wish for a son or a daughter, your desire will be fulfilled; further, if you give birth to a son, he will have virtue and wisdom, and if you give birth to a daughter, she will be virtuous and beautiful. Because in the Sutra of Universal Gate, the bodhisattva has made that vow.

You often recite Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva: No matter what dangerous situation you are in, you will feel at ease without any fear. Because the power of the Bodhisattva will protect you and make you feel steadfast, due to this power, the Universal Gate Sutra praises his virtue name as 'Bestower of Fearlessness.'

You often recite Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva: Suppose in this life you are poor and lacking, your household is unfortunate, living in suffering, and being despised and mocked by others… due to the negative karma from past lives causing the present retribution, through his compassionate vow to save sentient beings and his vast power of freedom, you will no longer be subjected to those sufferings. Because he has the power to 'Eliminate the heavy karmic obstacles and sins'

You often recite the name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva: Suppose in this life, due to the need to live, you seek wealth, houses, benefits, fame, career, etc., you will also have your wishes fulfilled, because he has the ability to "Satisfy the desires." Not only does he satisfy wealth and fame, but he also has the means to guide you in practicing merit and wisdom. For his ultimate vow is to wish all beings to achieve "Great happiness and liberation."

If you often recite the name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva: You will no longer have to suffer the karmic consequences in the realms of evil, such as hell, hungry ghosts, animals, along with the suffering of birth, aging, sickness, and death. Because in the Universal Gate Sutra, he made a vow: "All beings in the evil realms: Hell, ghosts, animals; the suffering of birth, aging, sickness, and death, I will help them completely end."

If you often recite the name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva: You will not fear being harmed by evil spirits, demons, or any kind of sorcery or traps; charms and poisons will also not be able to injure you. Because the Bodhisattva has the power to subdue heavenly demons and control heretical beings.

If you often recite the name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva: You will be protected day and night by deities and benevolent spirits so that evil will not harm you. Because the Bodhisattva has great power and virtue, with many followers such as deities and benevolent spirits, they will come to protect you out of respect for the Bodhisattva's virtue.

If you often recite the name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva: If you wish to be reborn in any Buddha realm in the ten directions, your wish will be fulfilled. Because the Bodhisattva possesses supernatural abilities, boundless compassion and vows, and has pledged to save all sentient beings.

If you often recite the name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva: You will be able to eliminate the resentments from past lives, and the enemies or spirits to whom you are bound by karma will no longer seek revenge on you. Because he has the virtuous title "All hostilities will retreat," which means that all enmities will dissipate.

If you often recite the name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva: Or if you hear his name, see his form, and think of him sincerely, the merit will not be in vain, and later on, thanks to that, you will not suffer in the realms. Because in the Universal Gate Chapter of the Sutra it is said: "Hearing the name and seeing the form, the remembrance in the mind does not go in vain, and it can destroy all suffering".

Because: Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva has attained Buddhahood since a long ago, with the name True Dharma Light Tathagata, and has long accomplished the mind of great compassion and great loving-kindness, has realized all samadhis and dharani, possesses supernatural powers and inconceivable freedom. He awakens a boundless compassionate heart, thinking of all sentient beings suffering in the six realms, and therefore often uses his freely exercised supernatural powers to travel throughout the ten directions of the worlds, skillfully manifesting various forms, conforming to the thoughts of sentient beings to save them.

Moreover, because his vow to save sentient beings is so vast and profound, taking the salvation of suffering beings as his original intention, he not only manifests in this world of Saha, but in all other realms, even in hell, he also manifests to save them "He who does not kill does not appear in body"

In the sutra "Thousand-Hand Thousand-Eye Unhindered Great Compassion," he manifested the utmost compassionate mind, expressed as “Swiftly fulfilling all rare desires,” enabling sentient beings to quickly attain all their rare wishes; not only did he, out of his vast compassionate heart, and with his freely powerful spiritual abilities, have the capacity to fulfill all the desires of sentient beings, even those that are exceedingly great and lofty, but he also skillfully used means to guide sentient beings to arouse minds of non-attachment, minds free from defilements, minds contemplating emptiness, minds of reverence, minds of humility, and minds without agitation; thereby causing sentient beings to cultivate the Mahayana path through good deeds and dharmas.Paramita is practiced successively to enable sentient beings to attain the four fruits, attain the ten grounds, and progress to the stage of Equal Enlightenment and Perfect Enlightenment.

The Venerable Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva possesses lofty virtue and great compassion. In the Sutra of Universal Gate, Shakyamuni Buddha taught: “O Immeasurable Mind! Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva has such extraordinary power. If any sentient being respectfully worships Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, their merit will not be lost. Therefore, all sentient beings must uphold the name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva.” Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva has virtuous authority and brings much benefit to sentient beings, so why wouldn't we think of, or recite His name?

(Bhikkhu Thich Minh Kiet)

Namo Amitabha Buddha

Namo Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva

Namo Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva

tieu_de: FIVE GREAT MINDS PURIFICATION
tom_tat: (Nun Thích Nữ Hạnh Đoan translated from the document CHÚ LĂNG NGHIÊM) The five great heart mantras contained in the sentence cluster (104-108) are: Sất Ðà Nễ, A Ca Ra, Mật Rị Trụ, Bát Rị Ðát Ra Gia, Nảnh Yết Rị.
noi_dung:
FIVE GREAT MINDFULNESS CHANTS

(Nun Thich Nu Hanh Doan translated from the text CHU LANG NGHIEM)

The Five Great Heart Mantras are found in the sequence of sentences (104-108) as follows: Sat Da Ne, A Ca Ra, Mat Ri Tru, Bat Ri Dat Ra Gia, Nanh Yet Ri.

Sanskrit: Che da nim, a ka la, mo ri ty u, bari trayana, karim.

According to Venerable Tuyen Hoa, these five mantra verses are called "the five great heart mantras," which are the five heart mantras of the Buddha in the five directions.

These five major mantras specialize in breaking the spells of celestial demons and heretical paths. Whatever evil spells or dark magic they possess, when you recite these five major mantras, all their evil enchantments are completely destroyed. Not only do they break demons and evil spirits on earth, but they also destroy celestial demons and heretical entities in the heavens. When you encounter celestial demons or heretical beings and recite these five major mantras, they cannot disturb your mind. Whatever magical powers they have will also be ineffective. Therefore, these five major mantras are extremely important in the Lankavatara Sutra, highly efficacious, beyond imagination.

The Mind Mantra is the final lines of the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra. According to Master Hsuan Hua's explanation:

Every day, or each time you first recite the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra once, then sincerely recite the Mind Mantra 108 times. The Mind Mantra is the line:

“Án a na lệ tì xá đề, bệ ra bạt xa ra đà rị, bàn đà bàn đà nể, bạt xà ra bàng ni, phấn hổ hồng đô lô ung, phấn ta bà ha.”

This Mantra is indescribably wonderful. If in the world there is no one reciting the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra, then all demons and evil spirits will appear. This Mantra has two phrases: 'A na lệ, tì xá đề.' One phrase means "throughout the three realms," and the other means "throughout the ten directions." Once these two phrases are recited, worldly demons and heretics will have no place to escape. The power of these two phrases is truly unimaginable.

If early in the morning you recite the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra once, and then recite the Heart Mantra 108 times, you will receive immeasurable blessings. Therefore, it is said that if you recite the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra, in future lives you will attain wealth and prosperity for seven generations. This refers to seeking blessings from heaven and humans; if you do not wish to seek them, then naturally it is not necessary. If you wish to attain spiritual results, you will achieve your goal. This is called the 'Mantra Assembly' - by reciting the Mantra, an assembly naturally forms.

Regarding the Five Great Heart Mantras and the Heart Mantra, I have corrected them accurately in the article LĂNG NGHIÊM MANTRA - DIVERSE RESPONSES as Thông Đông shared in his reflections.

tieu_de: THE VENERABLE LANG IS VERY RESPECTED
tom_tat: Hạnh Đoan abridged (This is a report by a PhD, because he did not leave his name or a Buddhist website while sharing, it caused confusion or did not record his name. Therefore, I do not have his full official name)
noi_dung:
THE VENERABLE LANG NGHIEM IS VERY POWERFUL

Hanh Doan, abridged translation

(This is a report by a doctor. Since he did not provide his name or the Buddhist website while sharing, it caused confusion or did not record his name. Therefore, I do not have his exact name. I translated it a long time ago, originally not intending to post it, but now I am just posting it to share, anyone interested can read it)

1. STORY OF THE SNAKE FAIRY

A few days ago in Chongqing, a person in Beijing was possessed by a snake spirit, who said that it was 1,500 years old and had the ability to know humans' past and future lives. It predicted that in two years its lifespan would end, so it was very eager to learn Buddhist teachings in order to escape the cycle of reincarnation. Therefore, it had to return to take refuge in Buddhism.

The snake spirit really liked listening to the chanting of Buddha's name; it only feared the Great Compassion Mantra and the Lankavatara Sutra, so it requested that the chanting sessions morning and evening avoid these mantras, because if it encountered the Great Compassion Mantra and the Lankavatara Sutra, it would have to immediately flee far away.

From this, we can see that the White Snake novel is not baseless.

Buddha said: "All the houses where humans live have spirits and demons; there is no place without them.

I would like to tell a story related to this immortal snake. If you don't believe me, I have no choice, because many people don't believe it and think I am deceiving them.

I will say it again, this is the truth, and you can believe it. Because of this matter, I had to return to Chongqing.

The woman possessed by a snake spirit is a professor teaching at a medical school. Previously, she completely did not believe in possession stories, but unexpectedly, the snake spirit entered her body. Because her ancestors had long worshiped certain parasitic evil spirits, they also worshiped some animal spirits at home, such as foxes and snake spirits… up to her mother’s generation, she continued the worship.

Later, some members of their family followed the belief of worshipping God in Christianity. One day, a spirit entered the body of this female professor, saying that it would be best for her to study Buddhism, because currently she has a relative in Beijing who just recently learned about Buddhist teachings, so she should go to her house.

The person that Xia Tian mentioned is a female university lecturer at my school. Back when I was in college, this lecturer often helped me. Since my family lived in the countryside and was relatively poor, I couldn’t afford the tuition, so she often assisted me with the fees. After I graduated, she adopted me as her son, which made our relationship very close. On holidays and festivals, I often visited my foster mother, and on these occasions, I helped her whole family understand Buddhist teachings and venerate the Three Jewels.

The female professor of medicine (possessed by the snake spirit) came to visit my foster mother. The snake spirit spoke during that time, and I was also aware of this conversation with my foster mother.

Many people witnessed this conversation firsthand, including my foster mother's husband. He was a leader in the Ministry of Public Security in Beijing and is now retired. He was nearby and could see the situation clearly. At that time, the snake spirit looked at him and asked:

What's so strange in your heart?" (he had heart disease and had undergone surgery) Xa continued: "It's best for you to give up cigarettes and alcohol altogether, otherwise you'll be seriously ill five years later, leading to an unsatisfactory bust.

Currently, the whole family believes in Buddha, and there is a main hall in the house to worship Buddha.

The serpent has lived for thousands of years, so it possesses many divine powers, and it can see people's past lives.

At that time, my adoptive mother's house was showing pictures of my husband and wife, through my wife's photo, the serpent saw through me.

Xà tiên suggested to my foster mother that it wanted me to explain and guide it in learning Buddhism.

Xà tiên recounted: We have hundreds of descendants who want to take refuge (when it joins people to talk, there are still many followers currently with it).

My foster mother advised: Xà should go to my foster son by itself, it would be more convenient, but Xà tiên replied:

- He recites the Lăng Nghiêm mantra every day, so we dare not go near him. I cannot go near him. Please speak up and tell him not to recite the Lăng Nghiêm mantra, or set a clear schedule for when he reads it and when he doesn't, so that we can visit.

After that, the foster mother conveyed this message to me, but I did not agree. Because I cannot refrain from reciting the Lăng Nghiêm mantra.

Sá Tiên has some very interesting sayings; he said: There are many things that humans cannot see. Like this black box, it controls the television, called a TV black box, but it only receives a finite number of channels, 波長, and cannot receive longer waves. Yet outside there (just outside the yard) there are many things that you cannot see. Sá Tiên also said: Every household has ghosts, but you simply cannot see them.

What the serpent conveyer said has proven the Buddha's statement: Everywhere people reside, there are spirits; there is no place without them! (Trường A Hàm Sutra).

Confucianism also says: "The enlightened world has cause and effect, the dark world has spirits" (the enlightened world has cause and effect, the dark world has spirits).

Because I did not agree to stop chanting the Lăng Nghiêm mantra or follow a fixed schedule, the serpent conveyer could not come. Nevertheless, I still wrote down this story so that you can see the great power of the Buddha's mantra.

2. MAGIC ALSO SURRENDERS

There was a university professor, let's temporarily call him B, who boasted that as long as you provide him with your name and address, he could describe in detail the area where you live and could even reveal household secrets and guide you on useful things needed for life.

So colleagues rushed to register, submitting their names along with their residential addresses to him for the experiment.

Among them were Professor A and his wife. Every day they recited the Lăng Nghiêm mantra 21 times, very persistently, never missing a session. They also submitted their names to Professor B.

As a result, all the other colleagues were vividly described by Mr. B regarding their accommodations, and he accurately mentioned secrets and events from the past, leaving everyone impressed.

Only Mr. and Mrs. A were not considered by Mr. B. He couldn't figure them out at all. Mr. B then blamed the reason: Their names were not in his registration records, so he could not predict anything for them and he used the excuse of being too busy to check anymore.

In fact, Mr. B used dark magic (raising spirits) to serve his own prophecy work. But because Professor A and his wife recited the Lăng Nghiêm mantra a lot, consistently and regularly, no evil spirits or demons dared to come near their house. It's not that they didn't submit names, as Professor B wrongly blamed.

Translated in July 2020

tieu_de: ABOUT STRANGE PHENOMENA WHEN CHANTING THE LANG NGHIEM INCANTATION AND WAYS TO TRANSFORM - OVERCOME THEM
tom_tat: 1. Recently, you guys have been messaging Lam to ask about strange phenomena appearing on the body when reciting the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra, such as facial numbness, hand numbness, ... or feeling hot ... Questions related to that kind of thing. 2. First of all, Lam k
noi_dung:
ABOUT THE STRANGE PHENOMENA WHEN RECITING THE LANG NGHIEM MANTRA AND METHODS OF TRANSFORMATION - REMEDY

1. Lately, you have been messaging Lam about strange phenomena appearing on the body when reciting the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra, such as facial numbness, hand numbness, or feeling hot... Questions along these lines.

2. First, Lam is not a Master, nor has any attained Dharma, just has experience and practice to share. Second, Lam is not your Teacher, nor is always beside you, so here will discuss some general issues, if you have similar situations, you can figure it out yourself.

3. It is not only reciting the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra; sometimes when reading Sutras, chanting Namo Amitabha Buddha, or reciting other Bright Mantras, phenomena like the above can also occur. But because the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra has very strong power, the more you practice, the more your body reacts.

4. Your body has toxins, so when chanting the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra, the body will react.

4.1 Toxins come from eating food such as vegetables and fruits that have toxins, or eating meat from farmed animals with antibiotics.

4.2 Toxins accumulated in the body from childhood, innate since birth.

4.3 Poisoning can also occur from passing through places with negative energy such as cemeteries or contaminated land.

Now, when reciting the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra, these poisons will be neutralized and expelled through the pores, so one may feel itching, discomfort, or develop rashes.

+ Solution:

4.4 After finishing reciting the Mantra or completing meditation, use both left and right hands, place the index, middle, and ring fingers on the Thừa Linh acupoint on both sides of the top of the head for 1 minute, while focusing your mind on the soles of the feet where the Dũng Tuyền acupoint is located. This will guide the energy downward and let it flow out (you can stand up so that your feet touch the ground - soles facing downwards).

4.5 After reciting the Mantra in the evening, take some rock salt and soak it in warm water, then soak your feet for about 10 minutes. The water should cover the ankles. Soaking in this way also helps remove toxins from the body.

4.6 To become more refined and go deeper, one needs to switch to a vegetarian diet; in this way, the toxins from animals introduced into the body will disappear naturally as well.

4.7 When chanting mantras, remember to keep a calm and harmonious mind, gently look at the Buddha statue on the altar; in this way, your spirit neither scatters nor moves, helping to gradually transform bodily toxins without causing irritating itching or discomfort.

4.8 Dissolve a small amount of coarse salt - slightly salty, about a 500ml bottle, for daily drinking; in this way, the toxins in the body can also be neutralized and it is good for health.

5. The phenomena of body trembling, or if anything happens to the body with uncontrollable intensities, it could be that there is some spirit inside the body, or someone has been following me for a long time. But because I chant the Mantra, they cannot withstand it and thus create this effect.

Seeing this, then:

5.1 I gently observe my body, without resisting the trembling. Separate myself and observe. Keep continuing to chant the Mantra.

5.2 Or temporarily stop reciting the Mantra, then silently pray in your mind: "Dear resentful spirits and karmic masters, you are within my body, following to protect me because of past life connections. I understand that the power of the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra makes you uncomfortable, but I hope you rejoice and comply with this Clear Mantra; otherwise, those who will suffer are you. For your benefit as well as for the benefit of my practice, I hope you leave my body and stay within the range or area permitted by the Vajra Secret Seal to practice with me. If I accumulate merit through my practice, I dedicate it to you, hoping that you may soon be liberated from the cycle of birth and death."become a Buddha of the Dao".

Pray like this once to three times, then continue chanting the Mantra; in a few days it will be gone.

6. When chanting the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra, if you feel dizzy, nauseous, or dream of terrible scenes, reflect on your mind, see if you are angry at anyone or if anyone harbors resentment toward you, consider whether someone has cast a spell on you, or if others are using spirits to disturb you.

These are questions I ask myself.

If you realize that you are chanting the Mantra with a heart full of anger, then use compassion, joy, and letting go while chanting the Mantra, and it will be relieved.

If you suspect that you are affected by curses or black magic due to others' hatred, then pray:

"Oh, Masters and Ancestors of the Spell Schools, spirits controlled by others, please listen to what I say.

I myself take refuge in the Buddha Dharma, relying on the Buddha Dharma for my practice. Among the Three Jewels, the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Sangha are the most precious, and therefore nothing surpasses the Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha.

Opposing someone's practice, as well as causing trouble for me when I recite the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra, only brings harm to you."

Today I should rely on the Three Jewels and the sacred power of the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra, wishing that the Masters and Patriarchs of the various Mantra traditions will sever the bonds of the spirits with the Masters who have practiced and bound them, allowing the spirits to be free to transcend or to study with me, or go to whichever realm they wish to study. In this way, benefits will come to them and to me.

Pray like this 1 to 3 times, then continue reciting the Mantra.

7. Practicing study is like rowing a boat against the current; the harder it is, the greater the achievement. However, all is created by the mind’s delusions, illusions. Except for the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra, everything else is false. Therefore, using a calm and harmonious mind to recite the Mantra, with the wish to bring good fortune to heaven and earth, will make oneself peaceful and as desired.

8. After each session, recite "Nam mô Đại bi Quán Thế Âm Bồ Tát" 108 times per string, then dedicate the merit to the Vajra Mystical Teachers and Protector Deities.

Prayer: "I vow to dedicate the merits of reciting the holy name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva to the Vajra Secret Signs and Dharma Protectors, the Earth Deity Gods, and the Heavenly Dragons, so that they may increase in spiritual power, increase in Dharma bliss, and support practitioners on the direct path to enlightenment. If I make any mistakes during my practice, I sincerely ask all of you to illuminate and guide me back to the righteous path."

The Vajras and Dharma Protectors owe great kindness to Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, so if one happens to make mistakes, reciting the holy name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva will also bring forgiveness and blessings.

Remember that in the chanting there is the word "great compassion".

Namo Great Compassion Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva.

9. Time is not abundant, so it is also impossible to write in detail, meticulously bit by bit, nor is it possible to answer each issue of each friend, so Lam writes it here to help you with general similar issues.

This article has received great blessings from the Masters, from Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva and the Vajra Treasury Kings. May it be sent to those who are facing difficulties in practicing the Lankavatara Mantra, to soon overcome all obstacles, achieve good fortune, and have both body and mind at peace.

Lam Son Village,

tieu_de: VENERABLE PHO QUANG ILLUMINATES THE MIND
tom_tat: (The elderly ascetic monk who has been chanting the Lankavatara mantra for hundreds of years, explaining about the Lankavatara mantra) Nun Thích Nữ Hạnh Đoan selected and translated
noi_dung:
VENERABLE PHO QUANG ILLUMINATES

(The elderly ascetic monk, who has been reciting the Shurangama Mantra for hundreds of years, lectures on the Shurangama Mantra)

Translated and selected by Nun Thich Nu Hanh Doan

The Shurangama Mantra helps the world achieve harmony, the nation be peaceful, and the entire mantra consists of two thousand nine hundred words, with the merits of each word being countless!

In the Shurangama Mantra, it begins with the sacred names of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas and the removal of calamities…

In the FIRST ASSEMBLY, there is a phrase: “XÁ KÊ DÃ, MẪU NA DUỆ, ĐA THA GIÀ ĐA DA, A DA HA ĐẾ, TAM MIỆU TAM BỒ ĐÀ DA”“舍鸡野.母那曳。跢他伽多耶。阿啰诃帝。三藐三菩陀耶.”

It is to repay the kindness of seven generations of mothers, followed by the phrase: LẠT ĐÁC NA, KÊ ĐÔ RA XÀ DA. 剌怛那.鸡都啰阇耶, which is to repay the kindness of seven generations of fathers in the world.

In the FIRST ASSEMBLY, there is a verse: “SÁT DÀ NỄ, A CA DA, MẬT RỊ TRỤ, BÁT RỊ ĐÁT LA DA, NẢNH YẾT RỊ. 叱陀你。阿迦啰。密唎柱。般唎怛啰耶。儜揭唎,” which is the five-element heart mantra of the Tathagata. This heart mantra consists of fifty-four great divine beings in the king mantra, thus its marvel is beyond description. Reciting the Great Compassion Mantra 108 times is not equivalent to reciting this king mantra seven times. (At this point, I only translate; you should experience it yourself or refer to the further sharing of practitioners who are disciples of Master Phổ Quang, such as Thông Đông, etc.)

The SECOND ASSEMBLY is for saving sentient beings, and the THIRD ASSEMBLY is for directly attaining Buddhahood.

In the FOURTH ASSEMBLY is the lotus flower, the five characters “phấn tra” 泮 吒 represent the five layers of the lotus, and the FIFTH ASSEMBLY is the achievement of Buddha.

Therefore, it is said that the true words of the Buddha are not false in the slightest. Practicing according to the Buddha requires a sincere heart without negligence; one must focus wholeheartedly, cherish and respect this Lăng Nghiêm mantra. As long as there is a practitioner in the world who recites the Lăng Nghiêm mantra 24 hours a day, this earth cannot be destroyed, and people will not encounter accidents from swords, knives, guns, or cannons, even in the event of earthquakes, landslides, tsunamis, or fires… Therefore, all disasters arise from human actions. ONLY THE LĂNG NGHIÊM MANTRA HAS THE ABILITY TO ELIMINATE ALL DISASTERS. ONLY THE LĂNG NGHIÊM MANTRA CAN SAVE ALL PEOPLE.DISASTER, THIS IS COMPLETELY NOT A BIT DECEPTIVE.

The Lăng Nghiêm mantra can help ensure a peaceful life, a prosperous nation, the happiness of the people, and harmony in the family.

The Lăng Nghiêm mantra is the true word, the authentic word, spoken from the great Buddha's summit of the Tathagata. This mantra contains not a trace of falsehood – it is indeed the true word, the authentic word, absolutely without deception, absolutely without arrogance, capable of helping the Dharma endure in the world, and is a great divine mantra that promotes a harmonious world with national peace and people’s security. It is a sacred text between heaven and earth and a savior for all sentient beings.

The Lăng Nghiêm mantra is the causal condition of the Buddhas and is the path that helps one attain Buddhahood. When one has mastered this mantra, the mind becomes undistracted and unwavering. When the mind is free from any defiled thoughts, one will reach the highest state. At this time, the top of your head may radiate light, and your mouth may emit brilliance. Your entire body will shine, capable of eliminating all disasters, relieving all suffering, destroying all sins, and you will become a Buddha.

I just read this post from an old friend and it's quite interesting:

"......Hello everyone, I am a 17-year-old male. Through the process of giving up pornography, after many failures, I gradually came up with a method for myself and today I would like to share it with everyone.

• When we are addicted to indulgence, we unintentionally become addicted to erotic videos, and also become addicted to the phone. To quit indulgence, we must quit erotic videos, but quitting erotic videos is not simple at all. It is necessary to give up the phone first to force ourselves not to watch erotic videos.

In the initial period of giving up the phone, you need to spend time on sports, playing chess, watching TV,... any healthy time-killing activities you can think of. After 2 weeks, the discomfort of being away from the phone will significantly decrease, making it easier and more comfortable to give up. But if you don't have enough willpower to quit, then destroy it completely, seal the storage place, or, as we did, destroy the battery and charging cable.

If anyone can confidently avoid erotic videos without giving up their phone, be sure that you are not suppressing your desires, because doing so will lead to a loss of self-control and ultimately be in vain. Those who do not give up their phone but can avoid erotic videos do not need any method to restrain their lust.

When you need to access the internet, you can use a family member's device. After using it, return it; you must not use unreasonable excuses to access it. Sometimes the ear thinks of opening music to aid studying or working... but once leads to twice, twice leads to three times, and so on, proliferating endlessly.

• Secondly, consider which places are harmful to you. For example: toilets, deserted areas, dark places, bedrooms, warm beds with soft mattresses, filthy indecent places,... reflect on which places arouse your desires and which places cause you to cultivate lewd thoughts, and avoid them. If avoidance is not possible, prepare countermeasures for yourself, such as playing Buddhist music, chanting sutras, or bringing someone else along when you go there,... think for yourself a myriad of strategies suitable for you and that place.

There is some advice regarding living spaces. Specifically for the bedroom, turn on the light when not sleeping; when it's time to sleep, really sleep, don't lie there using your phone with the light off—that's dangerous. When sleeping, sleep on the floor for peace; during the initial period, sleep on the floor for about 30 days, or for those who want to be extra cautious to prevent relapse, the longer the better. When entering the bathroom, wear clothes; do not use soap when showering, shower quickly; men should not be slow or sluggish.

• Finally, improve oneself. From the mouth, do not swear or imply vulgarity; actions and gestures should be cultured and polite. Do not gaze at vulgar things on the street or at the opposite sex. Stay away from bad friends, ultimately examine where your speech and behavior are vulgar, and then correct them. As for thoughts, ui, this is difficult; Honestly, try your best, eliminate whatever thoughts you can. There are two types of thoughts: active and passive. If you don’t want to think about something but it keeps appearing in your mind, that is passive; try to pull your mind back through meditation, chanting “Nam Mo” or mental reminders (explained later). As for lustful active thoughts, it is the same: if you don’t want to meditate, chanting “Nam Mo” or mental reminders (explained later) can be used.

• In moments of uncontrolled lust when you don’t know what to do, recite 'Nam Mo Quan The Am' or 'Buddha Shakyamuni,' or even more powerfully, remind your mind by saying to yourself, "Hey... you disgusting, vile, foul demon of desire, you... quickly get lost!! When alone, emphasize it aloud... when with others, think it in your head, but it must be done with strong conviction.

Limit watching cartoons, because watching too much can cause them to appear in dreams and lead to nocturnal emission. Later, the discomfort went away and I had wet dreams, then the discomfort returned, and once I overcame it, the wet dreams stopped entirely and there was no more discomfort. So, even if lust is strong, it's not that strong after all; it's just that I am too soft-hearted.
