tieu_de: WHAT KARMA DOES A PERSON WITH A SHARP TONGUE CARRY?
tom_tat: Many people speak ill of others behind their backs but simply think they are just chatting gossip with friends and family – The karma of this does not exist. Next are the words and actions that cause harm
noi_dung:
WHAT KARMA DOES A PERSON WHO SPEAKS HARMFUL WORDS BRING?

Many people speak badly about others behind their backs but simply think they are chatting with friends or family – there is no escaping the consequences of this. Next are words and actions that cause division, stabbing, creating conflicts between "individuals with individuals", "individuals with the community", "community with community", etc. All of these will face consequences, heavy or light depending on the severity; the issue is only a matter of time.

Words that cause division may make the speaker feel satisfied in the moment, but later they may end up empty-handed or frequently encounter misfortune.

A TRUE STORY

There is a woman who often speaks divisively behind other people's backs. At her workplace, even if she dislikes someone, she remains silent in front of them, pretending to be sympathetic, but behind their back, she holds grudges, backstabs the boss and those around her, causing that person to be hated and ostracized. Some people in the company leave in discontent, and she briefly feels pleased. Then she clashes with the boss's wife, and she also resigns - reaping the "sweet fruit" corresponding to the actions she inflicted on the people she harmed. Later, she returns to her hometown to start a business, opens a restaurant, and a storm sweeps everything away. She tries to recover for a second time, but the second storm quickly hits as well. Bankrupt, out of money, she returns again.Ho Chi Minh City borrowed money to open the next restaurant, borrowing from this person to cover that person, borrowing and then repaying late or even defaulting on the debt, maintaining that restaurant for a while and then it also closed.

STABBING, SCOURING, SLANDERING, WHAT KARMA DOES IT CREATE?

The Buddha taught that life always follows the law of cause and effect, never speak ill or do harmful things to others. If you harm others, there will be someone to harm you back. If you deceive others, there will be someone else to deceive you.

According to Buddhist teachings, words that cause suffering to others are all ways of sowing unwholesome karma. Therefore, according to the law of cause and effect, they will also have to bear the bad consequences as usual.

Affectionate words can soothe the pain in the heart, and lighten people's sadness. And if encouragement is given at the right time, it can change the negative thinking of the other person. From there, gradually it will change their behaviors and wrongful deeds.

On the contrary, words can also lead people into the abyss of sin, possibly causing them to repent for their entire life. Among them, harsh and hurtful words are one of the causes that lead to such consequences.

Malicious words and harsh speech are words that are vicious, rude, insulting, and cursing; they are language lacking civility and ethics in communication. However, speaking harshly or loudly to a certain extent is not considered harsh speech. This is especially true in the process of parents educating their children or teachers instructing their students.

Bitter words that hurt others can also inadvertently bring harm to oneself. Not everyone is aware of this. Those who often speak ill of others behind their backs will, in the future, face retribution and live a lonely life, with no one caring or showing affection toward them…

Therefore, in our lives, we should limit, and if possible, avoid gossiping about others. Gossiping about others is engaging in one of the prohibitions in Buddhism. Especially speaking ill of others behind their backs or criticizing others are ways of sowing bad karma for oneself.

Criticizing others behind their backs often causes resentment and division. If we do not avoid these things, we will face similar consequences. Whatever we criticize in others, in the next life we will encounter the same, unable to undo it and having to pay for all that negativity.

Many people see good causes and conditions but naturally act wrongly or badly. It is not because they are bad, but because in the previous life they acted wrongly, so in this life they have to bear it. That is exactly karma.

Some people often face slander or are spoken ill of; it is very possible that in their past life they cultivated this unwholesome karma. Even if in this life they do not speak ill of anyone, they are frequently subjected to slander, false accusations, and defamation. That is the karmic result they are unaware of.

According to the teacher Thích Trí Huệ, among the three deeds of body, speech, and mind, speech karma causes us the most loss of merit.

Verbal karma is the most difficult karmic force to overcome in spiritual practice; it is the greatest obstacle to attaining enlightenment; it is the strongest power for taking life; it is the main karmic force that leads us to fall into evil realms; it is the greatest hindrance to rebirth in the Pure Land; it causes the sanctuary to be impure, with continuous disputes; it causes the monastic community to be discordant, and the Dharma to not flourish; it causes sentient beings to lose their spiritual mind and sever their virtuous foundations as humans.

COLLECTION

*********************************

THE FRUITS OF VERBAL KARMA

In the Sutra of Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows, the Buddha decisively tells us that hell exists and that punishment exists. He points out that those born in this life either in poverty, or in families with hostile relatives, or with ugly or disabled bodies, blind, deaf, mute, without a tongue, with mouth sores, insane or mentally unstable, dying young,... or born as birds, animals,... are all beings who have committed bad karma through body, speech, and mind in previous lives. After experiencing retribution in this life, if they do not practice cultivation, they will continue to be "condemned to hell for many lifetimes, never escaping."

Each person has only one mouth; speaking good words and having beautiful intentions brings joy to oneself, making life leisurely while one’s character becomes more noble. Using words to belittle others, turning them into weapons against the innocent, remember that there is always cause and effect. Severe verbal karma leads to weak blessings, which are difficult to eliminate.

Excerpt from the Ksitigarbha Sutra

🙏 If you are someone practicing the Pure Land school, and you feel devotion to Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva and wish to venerate Him, then at home, if you have an altar for the Western Three Holy Ones and regularly chant Amitabha Buddha, you can place a small statue of Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva next to it. Every day when you venerate Amitabha Buddha, you are also venerating Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva, and chanting Amitabha Buddha is also like chanting Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva. There is no need to count how many times you chant Amitabha Buddha, Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, or Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva, as that is very cumbersome. Simply chanting the holy name of Amitabha Buddha is sufficient.

🙏 A DI ĐÀ BUDDHA, PLEASE CONSTANTLY RECITE.

🙏 (Excerpt from Kṣitigarbha Sutra, Volume 46)

🙏 PS TỊNH KHÔNG.

P/s: Anyone who is ill only needs to diligently recite the Kṣitigarbha Sutra, or sincerely chant the name of Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha 1,000 times each day, and he will appear.

Even when suffering from severe illness and near death, if one constantly calls His name, all ailments are eliminated. It is similar to a hungry child constantly crying out for their parents, so the parents must take care of it properly. But one must always remember that repeating the name 10,000 times in a week will yield excellent results.

If the person reciting this Sutra does not practice any spiritual cultivation, and their body, speech, and mind are still full of bad habits such as greed, anger, wrong views, jealousy, envy, etc., then no matter how many times they recite, it will not be effective, but merely a futile effort.

In hell, people wearing monk-like robes line up to wait for King Yama's judgment in countless numbers. The second row consists of women, punished for their harmful speech. The third row consists of men, guilty of debauchery, no less. Only when hell is devoid of people will Kṣitigarbha agree to become a Buddha, showing that his heart is always devoted to helping sentient beings. So why are you still hesitant to practice? If tomorrow you suddenly take your last breath, it would be deeply regrettable.

I rejoice when anyone shares the Dharma. I dedicate all good deeds of one day and countless eons to the ten directions of precepts, to all karmic enemies and debt holders, and to all beings throughout the Dharma realm, wishing them to swiftly attain Buddhahood.

NAMO Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva

ALISA REMINDS

tieu_de: WHEN TALKING ABOUT RIGHT AND WRONG, MONSTERS AND DEMONS GATHER AROUND
tom_tat: Why can't a person who practices asceticism achieve success? Living together, you try to listen, what they say is all right or wrong, good or bad. Ahead of me, I see a koan, I have also presented it to you. You
noi_dung:
DISCUSSING RIGHT AND WRONG THEN LOVE DEMONS AND GHOSTS SURROUND

Why can't monks achieve success? Living together, you try to listen, everything they say is either right or wrong, good or bad. Ahead of me, I see a koan, and I have also presented it to you all.

He recounted that there was a meditation master who, while in meditation, saw two monks discussing. Dharma protectors stood around them, and after a while, the Dharma protectors left. A little later, demons and evil spirits arrived and surrounded them. What is the reason for this? The meditation master said, in the beginning, these two people were discussing the Dharma, so the Dharma protectors surrounded them. After a while, when these two talked about other people, the Dharma protectors left and were no longer there. When speaking about others, they were discussing right and wrong, so demons and evil spirits appeared. Therefore, often discussing right and wrong, debating what is good or bad.then you should know that all around you are demons and evil spirits, there are no guardian deities.

How can one receive the protection of Buddhas and the blessings of dragons, heavenly beings, and benevolent spirits? The mind being in the path—that is the response of the Dao. When we initiate a thought with feeling, the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas immediately respond. If our feeling is unwholesome, then demons and evil spirits will respond. Where do demons and evil spirits come from? It is because you summon them; they do not seek you out—they come because you seek them. If you seek them, they arrive immediately. A single evil thought or a single evil word can summon demons and evil spirits. If a practitioner engages in such actions, is it not utterly wrong?

Therefore, remember well, the teachings of the ancients are extremely reasonable.

"Knowing few things brings few troubles," matters that are unrelated to you do not need your attention. People who are not necessary to know should be contacted less, because such contact brings no benefit and much gossip. In ancient times, why did practitioners choose to live in deep mountains, places where no human footprints reached? Their minds were pure, making achievements easier. Nowadays, we live in cities, which is the worst environment. Living in the worst environment, if you still want to gossip everywhere and pry into everything, how can you succeed? You have no hope of achievement! Therefore, if we want to achieve, we must first know how to protect ourselves.me.

Excerpt from: Thái Thượng Cảm Ứng Thiên (volume 27)

tieu_de: Recite the name of Kṣitigarbha 10,000 times + exclusively chant the Śūraṅgama mantra, and the land will be sold immediately.
tom_tat: Hello everyone, the year 2023 is the year with the highest rate of people going bankrupt, and I am one of them. My family invests in real estate, but at this time the land market is frozen, almost no transactions can be made, we have to sell at a loss.
noi_dung:
Chanting Kṣitigarbha's name 10,000 times + exclusively reciting the Śūraṅgama mantra, sell land immediately.

Hello everyone, 2023 is the year with the highest rate of people going bankrupt, and I am one of them.

My family invests in real estate, but at this time the land market is frozen, almost impossible to transact, even selling at a loss is still difficult to close a deal.

The scene of having debts piled up near Tet makes me feel like wanting to be depressed. But I always believe that Buddhas and Bodhisattvas can appear and save in the blink of an eye, it's just a question of whether I am worthy or not.?

I have always placed my trust in the teachings of the Buddha and always remember what Ananda said in the Medicine Buddha Sutra:

“Homage to the World-Honored One,

The sun and moon can be made to fall,

The high and mighty mountain can be made to collapse,

But the words spoken by the Buddhas cannot go wrong.”

The words that the Buddhas have taught in the sutras are infallible, so one should follow exactly what the Buddha said. The Buddha taught in the Kṣitigarbha Sutra that those who read the Kṣitigarbha Sutra will be protected by Earth Deities and various spirits. If they encounter calamities, reciting the name of Kṣitigarbha 10,000 times per day will allow them to overcome both major and minor misfortunes.

So I wholeheartedly believe that Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha will definitely save me. Therefore, I chant His name from morning to evening. And indeed, that evening a customer inquired about buying land, the next morning they put down a deposit, and the day they made the deposit was a Sunday, so the bank was closed; on Monday, they went to the bank and paid the full amount. It truly is miraculous.

But I would also like to add, if you want a spiritual response, you definitely have to be vegetarian, everyone. I myself have had experiences like this. Normally, I eat vegetarian about 20 days a month. I still have cravings for food and family obligations, so I find many reasons not to be strictly vegetarian. In past times, I would recite Kṣitigarbha 10,000 times a day and chant the Lăng Nghiêm mantra. Every time I did that, it was miraculous—people would come to ask to buy land and even agree to finalize the deal, sometimes even placing a deposit. But every time this happened, my husband would invite me to celebrate, saying that since there is good news today, his wife should eat a meal together with him. And sure enough, the next day, they would ask for the deposit back, and other times, they...Canceled, not buying anymore, this has happened at least 3 times already. So this time I acknowledged my mistake, and I vowed to completely follow a vegetarian diet. My husband also saw that every time I ate non-vegetarian food, things would go wrong, so he was also afraid and prayed that from now on he would support his wife in eating vegetarian, and that very evening a guest asked and they paid immediately in the blink of an eye.

Let me add a little that I also often wake up at 3-4 a.m. to recite the Lăng Nghiêm mantra, usually 20-30 rounds each day.

I am sharing this post so that everyone can firmly believe in the teachings of the sutras, in the spiritual power of Bodhisattva Địa Tạng, and in the spiritual power of the Lăng Nghiêm mantra. But if you want to escape calamities quickly, you must practice vegetarianism. If you are facing great difficulties, reciting sutras and chanting Buddha’s name but have not been saved, consider that it is very likely mostly because you have not maintained a vegetarian diet. My advice is for those who are in despair, not intended to debate vegetarianism versus non-vegetarianism. Please be joyful, everyone.

I am just an ordinary person, so I am still facing many hardships. I only hope that during my practice, I will be protected by the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas to be able to practice peacefully; I do not practice merely to escape the troubles of the world. I practice to let go and wholeheartedly aspire to the Western Pure Land, to be able to follow the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas 🙏

Namo Lingyin Assembly Supreme Buddha Bodhisattva 🙏

Namo Great Vow Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva 🙏

Anonymous from the Lingyin Enlightenment Group

tieu_de: YOU MUST RESPECT The Śūraṅgama Mantra
tom_tat: Venerable Master Phổ Quang, 123 years old, has been chanting the Lăng Nghiêm mantra for over 100 years, totaling more than 5.6 million times. He said:
noi_dung:
YOU MUST RESPECT THE MONK SERIOUSLY

Great Elder Monk Phổ Quang

123 years old, has been chanting the Lăng Nghiêm mantra for more than 100 years, totaling over 5.6 million times. He said:

"I say month after month, year after year, that the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra is the king of mantras and the mother of scriptures. What is the King of mantras? That is, the Great Compassion Mantra and the Ten Minor Mantras along with 54 other mantras are all contained within the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra; What is the mother of scriptures? That is, all the scriptures spoken by the Buddha are included in the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra.

Master Lăng Nghiêm reads correctly without missing a single word. If you recite thirty-six thousand times, there will be a lotus under your body, a lotus that your rebirth has been predetermined, a lotus supporting your feet as you walk. At this moment, there truly is a lotus embracing your feet as you walk in the void.

After chanting it thirty-six thousand times, it will manifest in your body and mind. If you chant the mantra even more, it will transform to save your parents. Parents from seven lifetimes and even parents from more distant past lives can be liberated.

The Lăng Nghiêm Mantra contains incantations to repay the gratitude of parents, such as the phrase: "Xá kê dã mẫu na duệ," which is the mantra to repay the mother's gratitude in the seventh life; "Lạt đát na kê đô ra xà dạ" is the mantra to repay the father's gratitude in the seventh life. You must cherish the Lăng Nghiêm Mantra.

Namo Lăng Nghiêm Assembly of Supreme Buddhas and Bodhisattvas 🙏🙏🙏

Source: Trish Ly

tieu_de: Chanting the Kṣitigarbha Sutra, maggots crawl messily from the sewer holes while listening to the sutra.
tom_tat: Dear Ms. Alisa, first of all I would like to thank you, your writings have helped me realize how truly wonderful and miraculous the teachings of Buddha are. Today I am free, so I will tell my older brothers and sisters, aunts and uncles together to listen. Year
noi_dung:
CHANTING THE Kṣitigarbha SUTRA WHILE MAGGOTS CRAWL CHAOTICALLY FROM UNDER THE DRAIN TO LISTEN TO THE SUTRA

Dear Ms. Alisa, first of all, I would like to thank you. Your writings have helped me realize that the Dharma is truly wonderful and miraculous.

Today, I am free, so I want to share my story with my brothers, sisters, aunts, uncles, and others. The year 2019 was an extremely difficult year for me, with hardships piling up. I lost my job, and my life became depressing and sad, feeling stuck. I fell into a state of frustration, partly leading to illness, and each doctor diagnosed a different disease. In general, I went for a check-up once a week, but it was the same every time.

One time while scrolling through Facebook, I don't know if it was fate, I came across Buddhism and read Alisan's posts. I gradually became enlightened; I felt as if I was lying within those writings. Then I actively messaged her, asked her to teach me, and with her dedication, she helped me gradually get to know the Great Compassion Mantra and the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra. Honestly, I didn't really believe much and only chanted casually. But one time, my whole family—my wife, my child, and I—contracted Covid, this century's disease that has taken many lives in our country, and the world was also in mourning.

Actually, I was really scared, because at that time there was no vaccine, and in my heart I could only pray and seek help from the Bodhisattva to relieve suffering and danger. I immediately thought of Ms. Alisa and messaged her for help, and she told me to keep reciting the Great Compassion Mantra 7 times plus 1 time the Kṣitigarbha Sutra, while always repenting sincerely for past wrongdoings. I listened and recited the full set of the Great Compassion Mantra that she sent me very thoroughly. I followed that guide to read. Sitting and reciting in my mind, I always prayed to Buddha for help, not thinking of anything else, because during that time when I had COVID, I was scared that my child was still very young, and if I died and my wife died, who would take care of our child? So I kept reading and rereading that Great Compassion Mantra.

Because I didn't memorize it, I just held my phone and read. I read until the fourth day when I accidentally bought a test stick to test, and the two lines were still faint, so I chanted the name of Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara, who saves from suffering and disaster, while sitting and mumbling the recitations.

Then on the fifth day, by chance the ward asked us to get tested. I took the whole family to get tested, still chanting Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva to save from suffering and disaster. At that stage, anyone tested was still positive, but when it was my family's turn, oh, that moment felt like an explosion of joy because my whole family tested negative. I was very happy because at that stage, it would normally take 15 days to turn negative. I was overjoyed but didn't stop chanting...

Then I came to the Land Organ Sutra, this was also the first time I read it, so I still sat and read it. The first part of the article on the Land Organ Sutra that Ms. Alisa sent me was a ritual of chanting, this part I couldn't help but believe a scene because it hit my eyes: Naturally, a gust of wind blew loudly, generally about 15 seconds, but I didn't pay much attention at first, after entering the Land Organ Sutra, oh my God! A terrible image was revealed as a swarm of maggots appearing from under the drain

.

My family has never had maggots before, right? Yet somehow a whole swarm of maggots appeared out of nowhere, and I didn’t even notice as they crawled onto the spot where I was chanting sutras. My dad shouted in panic, and my dad and my wife were like, 'Where did so many maggots come from?' Then he just grabbed a scoop of water to rinse them away, while I sat there pale and frozen. Later, I messaged Ms. Alisa to tell her about it, and she said that our ancestors came to listen to the sutras; in their previous lives, they didn’t believe in karma, so when they died, they got trapped and rolled around in the cycle of the six realms.

Oh! I am a person who doesn't believe in Buddhism, yet it still happened right before my eyes, the gust of wind that suddenly blew—I kept wondering about it for a long time. Where did the wind come from? It was so hot, and our small house was blocked by several large houses, so how could the wind blow so strongly for just 15 seconds?

From that period on, I became even more deeply convinced about the repentance section in the sutra: When I read this part, it would always bring up the acts of killing I had done as a child, and reflecting on them, I realized I was truly wicked.

I want to tell a story from when I was a child at school. I saw a garden snake, which hadn’t done anything wrong, and I threw a stone at it and bopped it on the side of its head. Also, back then, when I was drunk, I went to the toilet and saw a cat standing there. I caught it, held it underwater until it drowned, and then plucked its fur to eat it. Thinking back, I realize I was really cruel.

Then, when I read the confessions of those old images, those things came to mind, even though they happened a long, long time ago (the time I threw a stone at the snake's head, resulting in my middle ear infection and losing hearing in one ear, and regarding the cat, I got a very strange illness in my body, and as I mentioned earlier, the doctors couldn't figure out the disease. I suffered a lot, eating and going to the hospital repeatedly, but they couldn't find the illness, and in the middle of the night, I would have trouble breathing).

When chanting the repentance of the sins mentioned in the sutra, those sinful deeds keep appearing in my mind, and I feel so guilty for my wrongdoings. I silently pray for repentance in my heart, then I come to the dedication section, dedicate the merit, and ask for forgiveness because in the past, I was ignorant and naive, not realizing the consequences. Now that I see them, I sincerely ask for pardon.

At that time, I was going through a difficult life, losing all my jobs and drowning in debt, living in drinking and debauchery, having lost all faith. Coincidentally, that year was the year COVID came along, and what caught my eye were some posts by Ms. @Alisa. I don’t know who guided me to browse Facebook, but what caught my eyes were her posts. I started messaging her, asking for guidance in things I didn’t know. Gradually, I gained the confidence to message Ms. Alisa about things I didn’t understand, asking her to explain. Then, little by little, I gradually realized... Overall, I am very grateful to her.

During the COVID year, I got COVID too, and thanks to chanting Buddha's name, my child and I only had mild symptoms for about 3-4 days before testing negative. As for my illnesses, each doctor diagnosed me with different conditions: anxiety disorder, depression, autonomic nervous system disorder. In general, I had to go to the psychiatric hospital once a week for check-ups, yet there was still only one conclusion—each doctor diagnosed me with a different illness. I lost my job. Oh, you can't imagine how I was during that period; I felt like a complete failure.

So brothers and sisters, it's not something that ends in a day or two. I continued like this and then I got a job, going to work on my own, doing whatever was asked of me. Then I practiced releasing animals and giving alms, and from time to time recited mantras and the Kṣitigarbha Sutra. After 2-3 years, I gradually became stable again. I still worked and had enough to eat, not plenty, but it wasn’t as bad as in the early period.

Time flies, it's been nearly 4-5 years. Now I am the manager of a company that provides delivery services. I have a very strong team; everyone is united, loves each other, helps each other, and still manages to make a living. Looking back, I realize that Buddhism is truly miraculous and responsive. Through this writing, I am very grateful to Ms. Alisa, who was the first person to guide me on the path of spiritual practice. I hope everyone believes in Buddhism. I went from being an atheist, knowing nothing about Buddhism, not believing in it, yet Buddhism has transformed me. Now I get to live joyfully with my wife and children, fully happy.

In this article, I also advise those who are in despair not to be desperate; try praying to Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva for help. Never think of ending your life, as suicide is the most foolish thing, because death will not solve anything and you may fall into hell, the realm of hungry ghosts, or the animal realm to repay the karma you created while alive—you cannot escape it. When you return to the human world, you may be born in wild, dangerous areas without Buddhist teachings, in poverty or with illness, and will die repeatedly many times if you do not practice. I urge everyone to strive in practice, and to liberate animals, give charity, and perform other good deeds to resolve past karma and improve your destiny.

will be bright.

- Homage to Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva of Great Compassion and Mercy

- Homage to Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva of Great Vows

May the merit of this be dedicated so that all sentient beings throughout the Dharma realm can completely attain Buddhahood.

tieu_de: BUDDHA EXPLAINS THE MERIT OF THOSE WHO UPHOLD AND CIRCULATE THE LANKA SUTRA (Excerpt: Lankavatara Sutra – Volume
tom_tat: Hey Ananda! Suppose someone brings seven treasures filled with the void throughout the ten directions to offer to the Buddhas as many as the number of dust particles with a mind of service in every thought. What do you think? With the causal conditions of offering
noi_dung:
THE BUDDHA TEACHES THE MERIT OF THOSE WHO RECITE AND CIRCULATE THE LANKA SUTRA (Excerpt: Lankavatara Sutra – Volume

"Ananda! Suppose there is a person who brings the seven treasures, filling the emptiness in all ten directions, to offer to the Buddhas as many times as there are dust particles, with a mind devoted to offering in every moment of recollection. What do you think? With such conditions of offering to the Buddhas, would that person obtain much merit?"

Venerable Ananda replied:

"The void is infinite, so the quantity of treasures is also boundless. In ancient times, there were beings who only offered seven coins to the Buddha. After giving up their physical body, they still attained the position of a Wheel-Turning King. How much more so is the merit of those who make offerings to the Buddhas with treasures that fill the Buddha realms, extending to the ends of the void. Even if someone tried to count over countless eons, it could not be finished. How could such merit have any limit?" The Buddha said to Ananda:

"All Buddhas Tathagata never speak false words. Suppose there is someone who violates all four serious precepts and the ten prohibitive precepts, in an instant, they immediately fall into the Avici Hell in this world, then go through other worlds, and eventually have to endure all the Avici Hells in the ultimate worlds of the ten directions. However, if in a single thought they propagate this Dharma gate and enlighten those who have not yet learned, the sinful karma of that person will immediately be destroyed according to that thought. All the hells that they would have to endure in suffering will become realms of bliss. They will receive merit and surpass those who offer before them several times over."hundreds of times, thousands of times, tens of thousands of times, hundreds of millions of times, and so on up to numerical examples, cannot be calculated.

O Ananda! If there are beings who can recite this Sutra or can chant this mantra, even if I extensively speak of their merits for countless kalpas, it would still not be exhausted. Those who rely on My teachings and practice the Path according to the Dharma will directly attain enlightenment and no longer encounter demonic karma.

tieu_de: KING THAI TONG ENTERED THE CASKET TO THE EMPRESS TO SEEK THE PRIME MINISTER FOR RELEASE, THE EMPRESS AND THE PRIME MINISTER N…
tom_tat: [Video] TAI ZONG, THE SUGAR KING, POSSESSES THE BODY TO ENTER THE EMPRESS IN SEARCH OF THE PRIME MINISTER FOR RELEASE; THE EMPRESS AND THE FORMER PRIME MINISTER OF THE CURRENT KING NOW FOLLOW THE MONK TINH KHONG IN CHANTING BUDDHA. Below are brief excerpted summaries
noi_dung:
KING THAI TONG ENTERS THE CASKET AND THE QUEEN SEEKS THE PRIME MINISTER FOR RELEASE, THE QUEEN AND THE PRIME MINISTER N…

Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty entered a state of possession seeking salvation from the prime minister, and both the empress and the emperor's former prime minister currently follow Chan Master Jingkong in reciting Buddha's name.

Below are brief summary excerpts (including dialogues...) and, finally, a documentary film video "Emperor Taizong of Tang Enters the Body Seeking Salvation (Very Good)":

Emperor Tang Taizong (Lý Thế Dân) incarnated to seek liberation. It was truly moving; he returned from hell with destiny to be born as a female layperson (in a past life as an empress) and said that in this world, the collective karma of killing, stealing, sexual misconduct, and lying is already very great, and there is no other way but to recite Buddha’s name to be reborn in the Western Pure Land. There is no more time; sentient beings create all hellish karma, and those who do not believe will face the consequences. Venerable Master Jingkong also affirmed the incarnation of this Tang emperor in Part 3 of the lecture video "Cherish Life, Please Do Not Abortion and Kill Children."

The video clip is very good and moving, hell really exists and is extremely miserable. I hope that those who have the affinity will watch and widely share it, quickly and earnestly reciting Buddha’s name to be reborn in the Western Pure Land.

Below is a brief dialogue between Li Shimin (Emperor Taizong of Tang) and Master Zheng (Prime Minister Wei Zheng):

How severe is this great calamity? Very tragic, very tragic indeed.

Right now, what should people in this world do? How can we help them? So tragic to the point that the whole body feels agitated, why is this world so tragic, very tragic, very tragic indeed, very tragic, very tragic.

So, Li Shimin! What should we do now to help sentient beings turn back quickly? Propagate the Dharma, propagate the Dharma.

The problem now is if people's minds are anxious and have no way out, then what? Speed up!

By what method? What method should be used to propagate the Dharma, what is the simplest yet most effective? Recite the Buddha's name.

What about people who do not believe in Buddha?

Sentient beings are ignorant, and reciting Buddha's name is the best. I tell everyone to listen: this world can only be about reciting Buddha's name; practicing anything else is already too late, already too late, you are too late, quickly recite Buddha's name, it really is too late, you must hurry, recite Buddha's name. I plead with everyone to recite Buddha's name, each person must recite Buddha's name, everyone must recite, recite Buddha's name, there is only the way of reciting Buddha's name.

Beings nowadays only seek fame, literary prestige, material benefits, and compete for wealth and fortune. They do not realize that all of this is false. Look at me, Li Shimin, who have been a wise ruler all my life, who have become like this. Everyone, today I want you to see, I still have to recite the Buddha's name, yet you still have not recited. A wise ruler like me has already recited the Buddha's name throughout my life, so why are you still not concerned with reciting?

People nowadays are very hard to guide, so hard to guide, too hard to guide, this world is all chaotic. I just watched—what is this? What kind of insane world is this? No need for attachment, madness, truly madness, do not be attached. That’s why I am no longer attached, so I really want to quickly go to the Pure Land, leave this world behind, everyone must go, take the Empress (that is, the current Lay Monk Tăng Mẫn) along, do not be attached, rest assured, she is more than capable of becoming a Buddha, because she loves her husband so much, in this life she must become a Buddha, she can do it, you must let go of her emotional attachment, madness, temptation, foolish, foolish, too foolish.

Do you believe in Buddha and still end up in hell? Why end up in hell? I have created hellish karma, killed too many people, both Chinese and foreigners.

Do you know Tang Xuanzang? Was he the Imperial Preceptor at that time? Yes, Tang Xuanzang, he was my Imperial Preceptor.

Where is Tang Xuanzang now? He is now in the Pure Land!

Has he become a Buddha in the Pure Land? He has.

Why don't you seek him and ask him to guide you? Why come to me (Master Trinh)? The connection between you and me is truly great. Tell me, what kind of connection do we have? You are my chancellor, the prime minister, you are my prime minister. At that time, there was someone called Ngụy Trưng; you are precisely Ngụy Trưng, you are Ngụy Trưng, you are Ngụy Trưng and you do not know it? My chancellor, I am your emperor, you are Ngụy Trưng, you advised me not to kill many people, but I remained obstinate and deluded, my good prime minister, how could I kill so many people? What is a wise ruler for, if killing people is a crime?

At that time, Tang Xuanzang was the National Preceptor of yours who has now become a Buddha, why don't you go to the Western Paradise? The Western Paradise, I cannot go, I cannot travel there.

Venerable Master Jingkong teaches the sutras here 24/7, do you understand? I understand...

Nowadays, all the fame and fortune give me headaches and sorrow; they are all fake. There's no point in contending for those things, it's a waste of time. So much is fake, and it’s not to be blamed. Everything in this world is fake, completely fake. Don’t you agree that it’s fake? Do you think being real is good? In that case, the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas would not be so anxious. The Buddhas and Bodhisattvas are even more concerned than you; they are anxious. I am the same, doing things according to conditions is also doing good deeds. If you do it, that’s good. Master Tịnh Không, Tịnh Không Dharma Master is also my Mentor (Master Trịnh), you know that, right?

I know, I (Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty) really like Master Jingkong, I see that he does well. Venerable Master Jingkong (and those who advise us to recite Buddha's name) are good, there is no second person, you must not trust a second person, certainly not, you should not engage with external conditions, only trust Master Jingkong, Master Jingkong is good, really good, he is extremely good. The sentient beings in the world, evil karma has reached its limit, killing, theft, lust, and delusion have all reached their limits, all have created karma, because this world has accumulated too much heavy karma. The collective karma is too heavy, all have created hellish karma, oh heavens and earth. I just went through and saw that allIt is hellish karma; tell me, is there anyone who has not created it? That is why it is said that if one does not strive to recite the Buddha's name and cannot reach the Pure Land, one will fall into hell. The eighteen realms and six paths are not even considered; there are only two paths. Even if you speak, they do not believe. They still think they can return to the human world, or even ascend to the heavens, imagining that they can reach heaven. How could they do good like that? It is all hellish karma, all is hell; I am very clear about this in my heart.

So what should we do? Awakening someone, is it also doing? No awakening at all! Master Jingkong has also said, people nowadays have two paths: hell or the Pure Land, who believes it, thinking those words are false. The Master is true heart, only the Master's words are true heart, who else do you want to believe? There are some foolish ones who believe this or that, the whole world listen to me, believe only Master Jingkong, what the Master Jingkong teaches is the truth, everything else is false, believing in anything else is wasted time...

Please constantly recite Amitabha Buddha

Keep a Kind Heart, Peaceful World

noi_dung:
WHY BUDDHA SHAKYAMUNI DOES NOT ENTRUST THE MISSION OF SAVING ALL SENTIENT BEINGS TO OTHER BODHISATTVAS M…

WHY DID BUDDHA SHAKYAMUNI NOT ENTRUST THE MISSION OF SAVING ALL BEINGS TO OTHER BODHISATTVAS BUT INSIST ON ENTRUSTING IT TO KSỊTIPÁLA BODHISATTVA?

This is the time when Buddha Shakyamuni entrusted Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha in the heavenly realms, whose responsibility is heavier than anyone else's. When the Buddha is no longer present in the world, the mission of teaching and saving sentient beings must be entrusted to Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha. Where should everyone understand this principle? Why did Buddha Shakyamuni not assign the task of saving sentient beings to Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva? Why not to Samantabhadra Bodhisattva or Manjushri Bodhisattva? They are all great Bodhisattvas, so why not assign the task to them, but rely on Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha? To be honest, those Bodhisattvas cannot accomplish it; there is no way they can save sentient beings, only Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha can do so. Everyone, understand this meaning.What does this mean? What does Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva teach? Filial respect to parents and reverence to teachers. If a person does not show filial piety to their parents and does not respect their teacher, then no Bodhisattva or Buddha can save them.

– Venerable Master Tịnh Không, Lecture Notes on the Sutra of the Original Vows of Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva

I upload the Sanskrit phonetic transcription for you to view if you like, but it is not necessary to recite in Sanskrit to be valid!

_Salutations to the Lord Rudra, consort of Uma, accompanied by devotees.

_Salutations to Lord Narayana, alongside Lakshmi, in the five great mudras, performed by the creator.

_Salutations to the great time, Mahakala.

_Salutations to the Blessed One, the Jewel family.

_Salutations to the Blessed One, the king armed with the firm demon suppression.

_To the Tathāgata, the Arhat, perfectly enlightened one.

_To the Tathagata, the Arhat, the perfectly enlightened Buddha.

_Homage to Lord Akshobhya.

_To the Tathagata, the Arhat, the perfectly enlightened Buddha.

_Homage to Lord Bhaiṣajyaguru, the Lapis Lazuli Master

King of Light.

_To the Tathagata, the Arhat, the perfectly fully enlightened one.

_To the Tathāgata, the Arhat, the perfectly enlightened Buddha.
